jobs.title: Program Manager - Finance
jobs.description:
About CWS:

Imagine waking up every morning with the chance to change someone's life. Imagine knowing your efforts will benefit both your career and our neighbors around the world. At CWS, our team knows they are making a difference every day. Whether you're in our U.S.-based offices supporting refugees, asylees or unaccompanied children ... implementing hygiene initiatives in Cambodia or rebuilding projects in Central America ... or even connecting remotely from your home on fundraising campaigns, grant reports, or critical communications - you have the opportunity to work towards a world where everyone has food, a voice and a safe place to call home.

Overview:

Church World Service (CWS) is a not-for-profit, faith-based organization transforming communities around the globe through just and sustainable solutions to hunger, poverty, displacement and disaster. CWS does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, or veteran status in employment or in the provision of services.

Purpose:

The Program Manager - Finance is responsible for oversight of the financial operations of the Matching Grant (MG), Preferred Communities (PC) and Program for Initial Resettlement programs. In close collaboration with the CWS Corporate Finance Office, this position is responsible for developing, managing, and maintaining accounting and finance principles, practices, and procedures to ensure accurate and timely financial information is captured. This position will provide regular analysis of program budgets to the Resettlement and Integration Department Directors.

***This position is funded by a grant with a program period ending September 2027.***

Responsibilities:

**Essential Duties**:

  

* Support the Directors in developing and monitoring budgets for the programs.
* Collaborate with the CWS Finance Office on all financial matters affecting the operations of programs.
* Ensures CWS financial policies, protocols and standards are followed.
* Ensures compliance with uniform guidance.
* Coordinating closely with CWS Finance and Projections Departments, create and manage regular reports, forecasts, and financial planning, and make recommendations to the program directors on budget and spending.
* Maintain excellent financial records. Establish and maintain a system to track program revenue and expenses for CWS programs and for subgrantees.
* Liaise regularly (monthly and quarterly) with program implementing sites, CWS Program Finance and CWS Program HQ to ensure regular submission of required financial reporting, troubleshoot as needed with implementing sites as needed
* Monitor monthly national and program site expenses to ensure that CWS programs are operating within their set budgets.
* Advise Directors on funding available to determine staff allocations and ensure relevant program salary allocations are accurate in HQ Finance records.
  + In coordination with CWS Finance and Compliance Departments, draft guidance and template(s) for match backup documentation and tracking and providing TA on use.
  + Create monthly spending reports for delivery to network for review/TA in coordination with Program Finance
  + Creates new budget and relevant financial templates as needed
  + Provide training to CWS HQ staff on programs site budget review
  + Reviews and analyzes the actual vs budget report on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis for all active projects.
  + Prepare and conduct financial portion of site visits and monitoring and evaluation (M&E) of subgrantees.
  + Assist in preparation for audits by federal funders.
  + Develop and maintain sound accounting procedures and practices.

Qualifications:

Education & Certifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in finance or equivalent experience in lieu of degree.

Experience:

* Minimum of 6 years of previous work experience in non-profit accounting/finance with a strong working knowledge of nonprofit accounting/finance.
* Familiarity with OMB Uniform Guidance

Skills:

* Strong management and organizational skills required, including familiarity with financial management systems.
* Detail oriented. Strong analytical computer skills.
* Familiarity with government and private funding and contractual requirements preferred.
* Ability to work in a multi-cultural environment required.

Special Requirements:

* Remote, with proximity to airport is required.
* Must have access to reliable internet
* Must be willing to travel to locations in national network to provide on-site support on occasion and meeting with CWS Finance
* Ability to lift 50lbs. of weight, work in particular conditions, etc. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.
* Standard Work hours, 37.5 hours/week, with core business hours of 10AM-4PM EST, with occasional evening and weekend as assigned

Benefits : CWS offers a competitive benefits package that includes: - 403 (b) Retirement Plan - Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance - Generous Paid Time Off (18 Paid Days Off; 24 Days after 2 Years) - 14 Official Holidays - Sick Time Off (12 Accrued monthly) - Life Insurance and AD&D - Long Term and Short-Term Disability - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Health Savings Account - Flexible Spending Accounts - Commuter Benefits

jobs.title: Sr. Strategic Initiatives Program Manager
jobs.description:
What You'll Do:

The Sr Strategic Initiatives Program Manager is a strategic leader responsible for driving, projects that ensure Revenue Operations and Go-to Market (GTM) success. This role partners with executive leadership to translate business strategy into executable programs, ensuring alignment, and measurable results.  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced SaaS environment and has a proven ability to lead enterprise-wide programs, influence partners at all levels, and deliver complex programs from strategy through execution. You will combine program management expertise with change leadership, and the ability to use AI-driven tools and data insights to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

#LI-Remote

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

* Lead strategic programs that support Revenue Operations and GTM priorities from planning through successful execution.
* Partner with executive leaders to define program goals, align priorities, and ensure strategic programs deliver measurable value.
* Develop comprehensive program plans, including timelines, milestones, dependencies, budgets, resource allocation, and success metrics.
* Facilitate executive-level governance, steering committee meetings, and weekly status reporting, delivering concise updates, escalations, and actionable recommendations to senior leadership.
* Build strong partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Operations to drive alignment and execution across matrixed organizations.
* Lead organizational change management efforts, including stakeholder engagement, partner engagement, communication planning, adoption strategies, and process enablement.
* Drive improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, increase operational efficiency, and improve program governance.
* AI-powered tools and business intelligence platforms to enhance program reporting, forecasting, executive communications, and operational insights

What You'll Need to be Successful:  

* 8+ years of program management, strategy and operations, or consulting experience in GTM.
* 4+ years of direct experience in change management or organizational transformation in GTM
* Ability to manage complex programs.
* Strong strategic thinking, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance tactical execution and long-term planning across competing priorities.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills with experience influencing senior leaders and C-suite executives, including preparing and presenting steering committee decks.
* Bachelor's degree in business or related field.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Glean, Claude) and business intelligence solutions (e.g., Power BI, SQL) to enhance program management, reporting, and executive decision support.

Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Environmental Planning & Permitting (CEQA) - Pending Post
jobs.description:
Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.

**What are we looking for:** Woodard & Curran is seeking a Senior Project Manager with 15+ years of environmental planning and permitting experience to support a growing portfolio of water resources, infrastructure, and environmental management projects throughout California and the West Coast. This individual will be a trusted advisor to clients, leading complex environmental review and permitting efforts while managing multidisciplinary teams, agency coordination, project delivery, and business development initiatives.  
  
**What’s in it for you?** Join a collaborative and employee-owned consulting firm where you'll have the opportunity to lead high-profile environmental planning and permitting projects, shape regulatory strategies for critical infrastructure investments, mentor emerging professionals, and contribute to strategic growth across the West Coast. You'll work alongside industry experts while helping clients navigate complex environmental challenges that make a positive impact on communities and natural resources.
  
  
**Hybrid/Remote/Office** Hybrid or Remote (West Coast Preferred)
  
  
**Location:** California or West Coast Region  
  
**Travel:** 20% travel throughout California and the West Coast region for client meetings, project oversight, agency coordination, business development, and team collaboration.

### **What you will be doing at Woodard & Curran:**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by identifying environmental regulatory risks and developing strategic solutions
* Lead and manage complex CEQA (IS/MND, EIR) and NEPA (EA, EIS) environmental review and permitting projects from initiation through completion
* Develop regulatory and permitting strategies that align with client objectives and project goals
* Serve as the primary point of contact with regulatory agencies, stakeholders, and key project partners
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, forecasting, invoicing, and overall financial performance
* Perform technical review and QA/QC of environmental documentation, technical studies, field data, and subconsultant deliverables
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including environmental specialists, engineers, and technical subconsultants
* Support client relationship management and business development efforts for existing and prospective clients
* Lead proposal development, strategic pursuits, and marketing initiatives
* Mentor and develop junior staff, project managers, and technical professionals across distributed teams
* Monitor project progress and technical delivery to ensure client satisfaction and successful outcomes

### **What will you need to succeed?**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Biology, Civil Engineering, Hydrology, Forestry, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred)
* Minimum 15 years of environmental planning and permitting experience supporting infrastructure, water resources, and site development projects
* Minimum 8 years of project management experience in a consulting environment
* Extensive knowledge of CEQA, NEPA, the Clean Water Act, and related California and federal environmental regulations
* Proven experience leading agency coordination, environmental review processes, and permitting efforts
* Established relationships with California and regional regulatory agencies, including RWQCB, SWRCB, CDFW, DWR, USACE, and USFWS
* Experience developing permitting schedules, cost estimates, and environmental compliance programs
* Familiarity with environmental inspection and monitoring requirements during construction
* Strong understanding of infrastructure development and construction practices that minimize environmental impacts
* Excellent technical writing, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and team management abilities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Existing network of environmental and technical subconsultants throughout California and the West Coast preferred

*The anticipated compensation range for this position is based on several factors, including the candidate’s qualifications, experience, education, skills, and primary work location. Final compensation will be determined based on these factors and adjusted, where applicable, by a geographic differential. Geographic differentials are percentage-based adjustments that reflect variations in labor market costs across locations. As a result, the compensation range for this position may vary depending on where the successful candidate is located and performs their work. The examples below illustrate how compensation for this role may differ across geographic markets.*

**E-Verify Participation**: Woodard & Curran participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. As part of this process, we provide access to the Right to Work & E-Verify postings.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity & Accessibility:** Woodard & Curran is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to non-discrimination and make employment decisions based on job-related factors. jobs.title: Project Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Connected Care (OCC) as it refreshes and expands telehealth equipment at VA medical centers, clinics, and other sites across the country. This position will be fully remote.

Responsibilities:

We're looking for a Project Manager to support the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Connected Care (OCC) as it refreshes and expands telehealth equipment at VA medical centers, clinics, and other sites across the country. You'll be the day-to-day link between OCC, VISN Telehealth Program Managers, and field staff, keeping equipment requests, delivery schedules, and site communications on track.

This is a good fit for someone early in their PM career who already knows how the VA works and wants to grow into larger program responsibilities.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Coordinate telehealth equipment requests with VA sites and VISNs for technology refresh, expansion and provider iPad ordering orders
* Communicate delivery schedules to sites, track progress, and follow up to validate and finalize open orders
* Answer field questions on installation, ordering, deployment, decommissioning, and 1:1 replacement of end-of-life equipment
* Support recurring VISN Lead, FTC, and TCT calls, plus ad hoc Telehealth Technology office hours, and send out action items within two business days of each meeting
* Build and present slide decks regularly
* Handle incoming questions from field staff by phone, email, and Teams (order status, serial numbers, turn-ins, help desk tickets, vendor site visits)
* Support the OCC loaned mobile device program, including a master tracking log, order and shipment tracking, and check that site requests meet OCC guidelines and order limits
* Communicate equipment recalls to the field
* Maintain the Telehealth Technology Repository Sites: post deadlines, FAQs, and reference docs, build checklists and trackers, and archive outdated material
* Quality check data submitted by sites and follow up on gaps
* Produce the Monthly Synchronous/Asynchronous Equipment Delivery Tracking Status Report and contribute to program dashboards

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree with 2-5 years of work experience (or commensurate experience in lieu of a degree)
* 1 to 3 years of project coordination or project management experience
* Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to groups
* Comfortable juggling many sites and deadlines at once
* Working knowledge of Microsoft SharePoint, Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Strong written and verbal communication, including presenting to groups

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience working at or supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs
* Experience working with the VA
* Experience managing technology acquisition and reporting
* Telehealth or connected care experience, especially with VA Video Connect or OCC programs
* Familiarity with VISN structure and field roles such as FTCs and TCTs
* Experience with PowerBI, ServiceNow, or Maximo
* Equipment deployment, logistics, or asset tracking background

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

  
Posted Salary Range: USD $90,000.00 - USD $100,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Project Manager to lead multi-site implementation and rollout efforts in support of our federal customers' mission outcomes. In this role, you'll own the planning and execution of phased deployments across sites and business units, coordinating stakeholders, tracking dependencies, and driving projects from initial setup through go-live. This is a fully remote position within the United States.

Responsibilities:

The Project Manager is responsible for planning and managing implementation projects end to end, keeping distributed teams aligned and deliverables on schedule across all active phases. Specific duties include:

* Plan and manage phased rollouts across multiple sites or business units, from initial setup through go-live
* Coordinate with site and business stakeholders to gather, validate, and finalize required configuration data ahead of deployment
* Track rollout schedules and dependencies to ensure deliverables are completed on time across all active waves or phases
* Validate systems through test scenarios prior to go-live and confirm readiness with local stakeholders
* Communicate proactively and clearly across distributed, cross-organizational teams
* Determine appropriate escalation paths for time-sensitive issues and drive them to resolution

In this role, you will serve as a central triage point for the Intelligence Program's internal and external referrals, process and respond to 314(b) requests, and manage law enforcement supporting documentation requests. You will conduct open-source and internal research, assess exposure across Client platforms, route qualified referrals to the appropriate investigative queues, and ensure all activity is tracked and documented in accordance with program standards.

This is a **remote** **12-month contract position.** Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. No H-1B visa sponsorship available. Hourly rate: **$45.56. No C2C.**

**Responsibilities**

**Intelligence Triage & Intake**

* Serve as a central intake and triage point for internal and external intelligence referrals submitted via designated channels (internal referral forms, shared inboxes, etc.)
* Review incoming internal referrals against established program criteria to determine acceptance or rejection, documenting the rationale for all triage decisions
* Process external referrals from law enforcement, child safety organizations, and non-governmental agencies by logging, researching, and triaging incoming leads
* Conduct exposure and account matching across all Client product platforms using available identifiers (names, DOBs, SSNs, Cashtags, email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, BTC wallet information, etc.)

* Process employee/contractor referrals with appropriate sensitivity handling and restricted queue routing
* Support post-SAR law enforcement outreach by collecting SAR-related metadata and escalating it to team leads for formal dissemination
* Maintain accurate records across all intake trackers and assignment logs

**314(b) Request Processing**

* Receive, track, document, and triage all 314(b) requests from member institutions, ensuring timely and accurate responses
* Conduct open-source and internal database checks on subjects related to 314(b) requests
* Maintain accurate records and reporting on all 314(b) request activity, turnaround times, and outcomes

**SAR Supporting Documentation Fulfillment**

* Monitor and act upon SAR supporting documentation requests from law enforcement
* Track and document each request and follow up with law enforcement regarding any additional inquiries
* Interact with internal stakeholders to ensure full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and policies
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate internal teams as needed

* 2+ years of experience in EDD, transaction monitoring, compliance/AML, or intelligence analysis with a financial institution, law enforcement agency, or payment-focused company

* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills for tracking high volumes of requests and referrals
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfort working within structured workflows and documenting decisions with clear rationale

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Program Manager to lead cross-team, multi-vendor coordination that keeps the VA's patient-generated health data (PGHD) ecosystem running reliably, supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Connected Care. This role oversees delivery across the VA's PGHD applications, Validic's aggregation platform, and emerging integrations such as Google Health, spanning technical alignment, stakeholder management, cross-team orchestration, and data-quality oversight. The Program Manager enables national-scale delivery of device-derived health data to VA clinicians and Veterans, aligning program goals, stakeholder needs, and technical execution to mission-critical outcomes. Strong candidates bring program management and Agile delivery experience, plus the ability to navigate complex enterprise healthcare systems.

This is a fully remote (United States) position and may require up to 10% travel for quarterly reviews.

Responsibilities:

The Program Manager coordinates delivery across multiple products, vendors, and teams in a matrixed environment, supervising staff who may or may not be supporting the work this position functionally oversees. This role aligns efforts across engineering, integration partners, and system owners; manages schedules and status reporting; resolves issues to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals; and monitors progress across the portfolio, stepping in to solve problems with team members and stakeholders. Generally reports to a Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Lead.

* Supervise staff in a matrixed environment, including performance oversight, coaching, hiring, and professional development, recognizing that direct reports may or may not support the work this position functionally oversees
* Lead cross-functional coordination between VA teams, Validic, and third-party device vendors, aligning priorities, managing issue remediation, and communicating progress across CGM (Abbott, Dexcom), nutrition and sleep data pathways, and new device integrations
* Drive the Google Health API transition across the VA's PGHD applications and pipelines, managing discrepancy tracking, SQA testing follow-ups, OAuth/CASA approval workflows, and vendor inquiry resolution to keep step, energy-burned, resting heart rate, and sleep metrics accurate as legacy device APIs sunset
* Coordinate investigation and resolution of data-quality issues across multiple sources (for example, duplicate CGM records, dropped components in sequential updates, conflicting event ID updates, and observation-volume drops following SDK changes), synthesizing findings for pipeline teams and Validic engineering
* Facilitate vendor partnerships and support negotiations for new integrations, driving expansion efforts such as new CGM and activity-data pathways and the API and org-settings updates they require
* Manage pre-read and action-item workflows to ensure productive, well-prepared coordination sessions, producing pre-read materials, organizing agendas, and maintaining cross-team action logs across CGM, device mapping, pipeline fixes, and API transitions
* Oversee alignment across PGHD applications, mobile and web teams, and downstream pipelines, ensuring synchronized release planning, remediation of SQA-identified issues, correct application of device-definition rules, and consistent handling of edge cases
* Manage integrated program plans, including risk and status reporting
* Resolve cross-team blockers and escalate risks to leadership as needed
* Provide oversight of sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives across teams, ensuring they are carried out effectively and meet delivery goals
* Serve as a central liaison across VA digital health programs, collaborating with PGHD governance groups, clinical SMEs, OIT, pipeline engineering, and product teams to maintain unified progress toward national PGHD goals
* Manage vendor and integration partner deliverables, ensuring quality standards are met
* Advise clients on strategic and technical solution options

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and experience**

* Bachelors degree with 12+ years experience (or commensurate experience)
* Experience supporting federal programs or within the VA/OCC environment
* Familiarity with health data integration platforms such as Validic, or with CGM/remote patient monitoring data (for example, Abbott, Dexcom)
* Experience with health data API transitions or integrations such as Google Health or similar device APIs
* Experience with native mobile (iOS and Android) and web product delivery
* Background working with patient-generated health data (PGHD) or clinical data sources
* Knowledge of compliance standards, OAuth/CASA workflows, or healthcare-related systems
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks, APIs, cloud platforms, or DevSecOps
* Experience with backlog tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Experience working with distributed, remote teams

**Clearance required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

Posted Salary Range: USD $150,000.00 - USD $160,000.00 /Yr.

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  
  
Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

**About this Position**

The Technical Project Manager, Business Applications is responsible for leading cross-functional operational, business application, and integration initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, data quality, and business performance across the organization.

This role will manage projects from initiation through completion, with a strong focus on Microsoft Dynamics CRM, Sales, and PSA initiatives, as well as Intacct ERP, help desk systems, finance applications, reporting, automation, system integrations, and other business applications. The ideal candidate has enough technical depth to understand system configuration, data flows, integrations, testing requirements, deployment activities, and business process impacts, while also having the project management discipline to drive timelines, accountability, communication, and successful delivery.

This is a hands-on technical project management role for someone who can work effectively across business stakeholders, application owners, technical teams, consultants, vendors, and leadership. The right candidate will be able to translate business requirements into actionable project plans, understand configuration and integration dependencies, manage risks and issues, coordinate testing and release readiness, and ensure that technology initiatives produce measurable business value.

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end project management for operational, business application, integration, reporting, automation, and Microsoft Dynamics-related initiatives.

* Facilitate project meetings, document key decisions, track action items, and ensure clear ownership and accountability for deliverables.
* Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, configuration impacts, integration constraints, and decision points.
* Escalate blockers and tradeoffs in a timely, business-oriented manner with clear recommendations.

**Business Applications, Dynamics & Integration Management**

* Manage projects involving Microsoft Dynamics CRM, Sales, PSA, Intacct ERP, help desk platforms, finance systems, reporting tools, automation platforms, system integrations, and other business applications.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand business requirements, system configuration needs, integration dependencies, data flows, testing requirements, security considerations, deployment activities, and business impacts.
* Support and coordinate Dynamics-related initiatives, including configuration changes, workflow improvements, CRM/PSA process alignment, reporting needs, user adoption, testing, and release planning.
* Coordinate requirements gathering, current-state and future-state process discussions, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, deployment readiness, training, and post-go-live support.
* Ensure integration and application initiatives include appropriate planning for data migration, data validation, integration testing, security, user adoption, reporting impacts, and process alignment.
* Work with technical teams, vendors, and consultants to ensure configuration, integration, and application changes are delivered according to requirements and project timelines.
* Help identify gaps between business processes and system capabilities, and work with stakeholders to define practical solutions.

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, workflows, documentation, reporting, automation, and project delivery practices.
* Support business process standardization, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Help define and document current-state and future-state processes, business requirements, system impacts, project assumptions, and success measures.
* Introduce and reinforce project management best practices, governance standards, and repeatable delivery processes.
* Measure project outcomes and business impact against defined objectives, including efficiency gains, adoption, process improvement, data quality, reporting accuracy, and operational scalability.

* Prepare clear, executive-ready updates that highlight progress, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and expected business impact.

jobs.description:
The Data Analyst IV supports operations and conducts advanced data analytics projects to provide strategic information for decision-making or solution development. Implements and enhances data standards and deploys automation tools to extract, synthesize, and validate complex data from various sources. Constructs and manages large-scale data sets, monitors and ensures data quality, troubleshoots and resolves database issues to maintain high levels of data integrity.

  

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental – Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.

  

As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.

**ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS**

Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.

Must possess appropriate level of certifications for this position as required by the contract.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  

Leads and coordinates data development and analytics for Tribal healthcare initiatives.

  

Summarizes data needs of American Indians and pilots’ healthcare data development.

  

Inventories data resources, evaluates data needs, and plans/initiates pilot data projects.

  

Provides technical input for data infrastructure, analytic capacity, and data sovereignty.

  

Conducts environmental scans and develops comprehensive inventories of healthcare data resources.

  

Assesses data quality, completeness, and opportunities for linkage across systems.

  

Prepares management reports, including monthly progress and cost-to-complete reports.

  

Supports the development of quality measures and analytics for Tribal Nations.

  

Ensures compliance with federal requirements, including FISMA, Section 508, and records management.

  

Develops and implements methods for orderly and efficient project task coordination.

Drives the strategic development and execution of large-scale analytics initiatives that align with business goals and deliver measurable impacts.

Develops and deploys advanced predictive and prescriptive models to solve complex business problems and optimize performance.

Leads cross-functional analytics projects, coordinating efforts between departments to achieve unified goals.

Establishes and enforces organizational data quality frameworks, continually striving to enhance data integrity and effectiveness.

Incorporates complex data sources, including unstructured data, into analysis to provide comprehensive insights.

Guides the organization towards a data-centric culture, advocating for data-driven decision-making at all levels.

Utilizes advanced scripting and querying tools like Python, R, or SQL, as well as statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and data modeling techniques to produce sophisticated reports, data files, and interactive dashboards.

  

Mentors junior team members and may act as a team lead.

  

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

Masters degree and a minimum of eight to ten (8-10) years relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education/experience.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

Work is primarily performed in an office environment. Regularly required to sit. Regularly required use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms to handle objects and operate tools, computer, and/or controls. Required to speak and hear. Occasionally required to stand, walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Exposed to general office noise with computers printers and light traffic.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.

The estimated pay range for this role is $118,800 to $155,000, with the final offer contingent on location, skillset, and experience.

The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, translating business requirements into scalable API-driven solutions and supporting integrations across MDM platforms, CRM systems, patient services, marketing platforms, and downstream data consumers.

**Functional Skills**

EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified *E360 RCM*™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. Powered by proprietary algorithms, iterative intelligence from 10M+ processed claims, and expert human-in-the-loop integration, EnableComp provides solutions across the revenue lifecycle for Veterans Administration, Workers’ Compensation, Motor Vehicle Accidents, and Out-of-State Medicaid claims as well as denials for all payer classes. By partnering with clients to supercharge the reimbursement process, EnableComp removes the burden of payment from patients and provider organizations while enabling accelerated cash, higher and more accurate yield, clean AR management, reduced denials, and data-rich performance management. EnableComp is a multi-year recipient the Top Workplaces award and was recognized as Black Book's #1 Specialty Revenue Cycle Management Solution provider in 2024 and is among the top one percent of companies to make the Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in the United States for the last eleven years.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

  

The Data Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex healthcare data to generate actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making. The Data Analyst collaborates with cross-functional partners to translate business needs into analytical solutions and delivers clear, data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.

* Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions

* Partner with Operations, Account Management, Product, IT, and Data management teams to align data solutions with business needs

* Document methodologies, assumptions, and processes to support transparency and repeatability
* Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

* Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring
* Stay current on analytics tools, methodologies, and industry trends to enhance capabilities
* Other duties as required

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Finance, Business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration or other related field required
* 5+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or working with relational databases required
* 3-5 years of experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, or SaaS environment strongly preferred
* Familiarity with healthcare terminology (e.g., CPT codes, DRG, claims, inpatient/outpatient)
* Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik preferred
* Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform
* 3 years of integrating Databricks, Power BI, and Claude Code
* Experience in statistical analysis or predictive modeling techniques
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and experience writing SQL queries
* Timely and regular attendance
* Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

* High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, validation, and quality of work
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Demonstrated problem-solving mindset with the ability to independently drive work to completion
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while also working independently when needed

Seal Dynamics (A HEICO Company) founded in 1976, with its corporate headquarters based in Hauppauge, NY is a world leader in technical sales and the distribution of aerospace components.

Our unique marketing and technical sales approach are the most effective way to assist our customers in selecting products that reduce cost of ownership. Our current product portfolio includes structural, mechanical and electro-mechanical products associated with both airframe and engine applications across all ATA Chapters. Through our strategic partnerships with some of the most respected OEMs in the aviation industry, Seal Dynamics stocks and distributes in excess of 100,000 products globally in support of our customer requirements.

In addition to our distribution network, Seal Dynamics is a market leader in the design and development of FAA approved alternative parts. Our OEM licensed PMAs and Test and Computation PMAs offer our customers viable solutions in the reduction of operational costs.

Seal Dynamics is currently hiring a **Project Manager** to lead cross-functional projects and support continuous improvement across the company.

**On-site in Hauppauge, Long Island, NY. This is not a remote or hybrid position, and it is not a contract role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.**

* **Seal Dynamics offers a 9/80 work schedule, upon completion of the introductory period, you can opt to enroll and have every other Friday off.**

**Purpose:** The Project Manager role will act as the vital bridge connecting cross-functional teams across Seal Dynamics, including Operations, Sales, Accounting, Supply Chain, Information Technology, Product Management, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership to lead strategic projects and ensure program execution, contract compliance, and on-time delivery to commercial and defense aerospace customers using Continuous Improvement Methodologies. The role converts business KPIs into project plans, aligns stakeholders, manages risks and resources, and drives projects through successful completion.

Requirements:

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Plan and manage aerospace distribution projects and programs from initiation through closeout, including scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, compliance requirements, and stakeholder communications
* Translate strategic goals into work plans with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and clear deadlines
* Partner with Operations, Sales, Accounting, Supply Chain, Information Technology, Product Management, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership to define requirements and deliverables to meet and/or exceed business KPIs
* Lead Kaizens, Continuous Improvement workshops and cross-functional problem-solving sessions that translate business needs into practical implementation plans
* Apply Lean Six Sigma methods or Kaizen Tools to identify root causes, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and improve process performance
* Define, monitor, and communicate Seal Dynamics, NY, KPIs that measure project health, operational performance, and adoption
* Work alongside Data Scientist to create dashboards to provide visibility into forecasts, trends, risks, and results
* Partner with business leaders, process owners, technical teams, and external stakeholders to clarify requirements, secure decisions, and maintain alignment
* Support adoption of project(s) implementation by tracking the project benefits and developing corrective actions alongside stakeholders when performance differs from target to ensure Continuous Improvement mindset
* Prepare and present to senior leadership and staff project management statuses - project dashboards, presentations, and reports

**Knowledge and Skills Required:**

* Strong project planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource coordination, risk management, and change management skills.

jobs.title: Chemical & Natural Resources Cybersecurity Manager/Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**We Are**

Accenture's Cybersecurity practice, a global leader in delivering end-to-end cybersecurity services across strategy, risk management, digital identity, cyber defense, and managed security. With security professionals in 70 countries and specialized facilities like Cyber Fusion Centers and Cyber Labs, we focus on embedding security into digital transformation programs, and delivering targeted cybersecurity solutions to protect digital assets, manage cybersecurity risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We address the evolving challenges of cybersecurity in today's digital landscape. Our cybersecurity practice is supported by a global network of cybersecurity professionals, advanced tools, and partnerships with leading technology providers. We help organizations build resilience, protect their operations, and enable growth in a secure digital environment.

**You Are**

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Chemicals & Natural Resources (CNR) industries, including chemical manufacturers, oil & gas operators, mining companies, and agricultural enterprises. You develop and deliver cybersecurity services that protect critical infrastructure, enable operational modernization, manage enterprise and operational risk, and support compliance with industry-specific regulatory requirements. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide CNR clients through complex business, technology, safety, and resilience challenges. You assess current and future cybersecurity capabilities, advise on leading practices, and shape cybersecurity strategies aligned with each client's business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational realities.

**The Work:**

As a Cybersecurity Manager, you will manage complex information security engagements and workstreams. You will provide cybersecurity subject matter expertise, coordinate project delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for client security, business, and IT stakeholders, Accenture domain experts, and third-party teams. You will lead; manage plans, risks, budgets, and deliverables; and help shape practical solutions that achieve committed client outcomes.

As a team member, you'll be part of a Chemicals & Natural Resources industry team focused on applying cybersecurity expertise across the CNR value chain — from upstream exploration and extraction, to refining, processing, and distribution, through to chemical manufacturing and end-product delivery. You'll work closely with our CNR industry leaders to innovate and shape secure, resilient solutions for operational technology modernization, supply chain security, and industrial process safety.

* **Client Engagement:** Build trusted working relationships with chemical, oil & gas, mining, and agricultural client stakeholders, translating their cybersecurity, safety, regulatory, and operational resilience priorities into actionable workplans and deliverables.
* **Initiative Delivery:** Manage cybersecurity workstreams and project teams delivering solutions across cyber defense, AI-enabled security, risk management, and compliance, aligned with client objectives, scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
* **CNR Insight & Strategy Development:** Apply deep knowledge of CNR operations, regulatory obligations, threat trends, and technology modernization to shape practical client strategies tailored to chemical, energy, and natural resource environments.
* **Innovative Strategy Formulation:** Collaborate with CNR clients to create and implement forward-looking strategies that secure operational technology modernization, process control systems, supply chain digitization, cloud adoption, and IT/OT convergence while protecting worker safety, environmental compliance, and operational continuity.
* **Secure AI:** Support CNR clients in the secure adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning across industrial operations — including AI-driven process optimization, predictive maintenance, and autonomous systems — ensuring AI deployments are implemented with security, safety, and governance controls embedded from inception.
* **Team Leadership & Development:** Supervise and coach project team members, assign work, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing delivery environment.
* **Communication & Reporting:** Develop clear recommendations, status reports, and executive-ready materials; present findings and delivery progress to client and Accenture stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to align security initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cybersecurity assessments, strategy workstreams, and implementation activities across CNR enterprise and operational environments, including IT, OT/ICS, cloud, process control networks, distributed control systems (DCS), SCADA, historian systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES), while supporting applicable requirements such as IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-82, EPA Risk Management Program, TSA Security Directives, CIRCIA, API 1164, and industry-specific HSE regulations.
* Support senior leaders in advising CNR stakeholders on integrating cybersecurity risk management into operational resilience, capital programs, plant modernization, emergency preparedness, and sustainability initiatives.
* Manage CNR cybersecurity transformation workstreams focused on secure IT/OT convergence, network segmentation, internal network security monitoring, threat detection modernization, cyber resilience, and identity and access management for critical industrial infrastructure.
* Facilitate CNR-specific threat modeling, incident response, and recovery-readiness activities for risks such as ransomware, nation-state activity, supply chain compromise, insecure remote access, and attacks affecting chemical plants, ref

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Project Manager - PMO to join our team in Jersey City, New Jersey (US-NJ), United States (US).
  
  
Day to Day Job Duties
  

* Perform hands-on PMO activities supporting banking technology and transformation programs. This is a hands-on delivery role and requires the individual to personally own and execute PMO activities rather than only provide oversight or coordination.
* Work closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to track project plans, sprint commitments, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Prepare and maintain weekly project status reports, dashboards, management presentations, and executive-level reporting.
* Own and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Actions, Issues and Dependencies), proactively following up with owners and escalating items requiring management attention.
* Coordinate and support project governance forums, Steering Committee meetings, program reviews, and working-group meetings, including preparation of agendas, presentations, meeting minutes, decisions, and action tracking.
* Support delivery in an Agile environment, participating in relevant Agile ceremonies and working closely with Scrum teams to track delivery progress, impediments, dependencies, and commitments.
* Consolidate information from multiple workstreams and provide a clear view of overall program status, key risks, upcoming milestones, and areas requiring attention.
* Perform hands-on tracking of project financials including budgets, forecasts, actuals, resource costs, and variances.
* Track resource requirements, onboarding/offboarding, allocation, utilization, and capacity across project teams.
* Maintain project plans, governance artifacts, documentation repositories, change requests, decision logs, and other required PMO documentation.
* Work with business, technology, operations, vendors, and other stakeholders to drive closure of actions and ensure delivery commitments are met.
* Identify gaps in project governance or execution and proactively work with the project leadership team to address them.
* Support continuous improvement of PMO processes, templates, governance standards, and reporting practices.
* Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and be prepared to work from client locations when required.

Required Qualifications
  

* 10+ years of overall experience in PMO, Project Management, Program Management, or Project Coordination roles.
* 5+ years PMO experience is mandatory. Candidates must be willing and able to personally create and maintain project plans, RAID logs, status reports, dashboards, meeting minutes, financial trackers, resource plans, and other project governance artifacts.
* 5+ years of experience within Banking or Financial Services supporting technology, transformation, regulatory, or business change initiatives.
* 5+ years of experience working in an Agile delivery environment, with a good understanding of Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog management, dependencies, and delivery tracking.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Strong experience in project governance, RAID management, milestone and dependency tracking, action management, and executive reporting.
* Experience preparing management-level presentations and communicating project status, risks, issues, and dependencies to senior stakeholders.
* Experience supporting project financial management, resource tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to independently prepare high-quality project reports and presentations.
* Experience with JIRA and Confluence, along with project planning or portfolio management tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Clarity, ServiceNow SPM/PPM, or similar.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with business and technology stakeholders across different geographies.
* Must be willing and able to travel up to 50% to Brazil based on project requirements.

Degree
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience.

jobs.title: Asset Management Global Liquidity & Cash - Program Analyst (Client Advisor)
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Global Liquidity (GL), is a division within J.P. Morgan Asset Management focused on providing customized fixed income solutions to both domestic and multinational corporations, as well as, Financial Intermediaries. Our global investment solutions are delivered to clients through mutual funds, as well as, separately managed portfolios, across multiple currencies. With over $837.7B in assets under management and offices located throughout the world, GL is one of the leaders in short-term cash management.

**Job summary:**

As an Asset Management Program Analyst - Global Liquidity (Internal Client Advisor) you will be responsible for partnering with 2-3 Client Advisors to manage existing client relationships and proactively engage prospects to market JPMorgan Global Liquidity products and services. This role requires earning regulatory licenses and working closely with external salespersons to drive positive sales results. Key objectives include identifying new business opportunities, cultivating client relationships, delivering value-added tools and market insights, and ensuring compliance with onboarding requirements. Successful candidates should demonstrate proven results in client relationship management, cross-selling, and prospecting, with a strong drive for achievement and excellence.

**Job responsibilities:**

The primary role of the Internal Client Advisor (ICA) is to partner with 2-3 Client Advisors, covering their defined territories. The ICA will assist with managing existing client relationships, as well as, proactively call on prospects and market JPMorgan Global Liquidity products and services. The position requires accountability to an external salesperson covering their corresponding region, while driving positive sales results. Once in the role, the Internal Client Advisor is expected to earn regulatory licenses (Series SIE, 7, 63 & 3). Candidates should be self-starters who have a strong desire to succeed and to achieve goals in a consistent and timely manner.

* Work with 2-3 Client Advisors to identify and develop new business opportunities with clients/prospects, as well as, assist with their territory management
* Identify, pursue and close cross-sell opportunities with existing clients and prospects
* Cultivate and manage client relationships, by responding to inquiries, providing ongoing communication/updates and develop a comprehensive view of their business and investment requirements
* Deliver "the best of the firm" to key clients through value-add tools/support, product information/updates and access to market insights
* Coordinate with the Client Service Team to ensure proper onboarding and execution of KYC / AML requirements
* Ensure cross-team cooperation by identifying and promoting best practices, working closely with Client Advisors and the broader Global Sales team
* Develop and strengthen internal relationships with bank partners (TS, GCB, CB, IS, IB), JPMAM Portfolio Managers, Investment Specialists, Client Advisors and Client Service/Operations

**Required qualifications, skills and capabilities:**

* Proven results in client relationship management, cross-sell experience and prospecting. Demonstrates a drive for achievement and compels others to strive for excellence
* Ability to learn and use industry/product knowledge by understanding client needs, the competition, as well as, the marketplace
* Capacity to build relationships with both internal and external clients
* Demonstrates a working knowledge of fixed income investment products
* Bachelor degree required
* Licenses: Series 7, 63 and SIE

**Preferred qualifications, skills and capabilities:**

* 1+ year's financial services experience preferred and/or directly related sales experience

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Job Description

As an Executive Director on Chief Technology Office's Portfolio Management & Governance team, you will drive core elements of portfolio planning, investment governance, executive reporting, and process/tooling improvement across a large global technology portfolio. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will execute and own defined workstreams end-to-end, operate with strong autonomy, and influence stakeholders through clear, data-driven insights. You will help translate strategy into execution-ready plans and contribute to the teams broader transformation agenda—streamlining processes, improving data quality and tooling, strengthening controls and audit readiness, and personally building and operating AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and quality.

Elevate your career by steering multi-faceted tech programs, integrating innovative solutions for a dynamic impact across global operations.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Portfolio planning & investment hygiene:** Drive the annual planning cycles for the Chief Technology Office, in partnership with Finance & Business Management; own discrete planning workstreams as assigned; set standards, calendars, and guardrails; Establish quarterly planning activities.
* **Data-driven portfolio management & hygiene:** Use robust data analysis to manage the portfolio, identify trends, gaps, and emerging risks, and lead efforts to strengthen portfolio hygiene through accurate, complete, and timely data. Establish disciplined routines to monitor data quality, resolve exceptions, and translate insights into actionable recommendations for prioritization, investment decisions, and executive reporting.
* **Portfolio governance & oversight:** Enhance the governance operating model for Chief Technology Office's portfolio; ensure investment decisions align with strategy and financial targets. * **Risk, controls & audit readiness**: Embed strong controls in portfolio processes; maintain audit-ready evidence, lineage, and documentation. Develop and implement strategic technical program plans, aligning with organizational goals and cross-functional collaboration
* **Stakeholder management & influence**: Partner with Engineering, Product, Finance, and Business Management to align on priorities, dependencies, and outcomes. Coordinate with enterprise investment governance and line-of-business stakeholders to ensure consistency and compliance.

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Inventory Strategy and Ops
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Compass International Holdings is seeking a Lead, Inventory Product, Data & Ops to make sure our inventory products work as promised across all ten brands, and to rebuild how that work gets done with AI.

You will report to the Director, Inventory Product, Data & Ops. This team owns the technical and operational backbone of listing distribution: when a listing moves from an agent to the MLS, our agent platform, our brand websites, and portals, we make sure it happens correctly, on time, and per the seller's instructions. The Director sets roadmap priorities and MLS strategy. You own the operating engine underneath it: testing and validating what ships, helping build the AI systems that run our daily processes, keeping our reporting accurate, and keeping every workstream documented, tracked, and organized.

This is a hybrid seat. You understand the business well enough to know what matters to an agent and a seller, and the technology well enough to sit with Product and Engineering, read a spec, and see where it will break. You are AI-first by default. Not someone who only uses AI to move faster on their own work, but someone who builds, stress tests, and deploys AI systems.

Every inventory program Compass International Holdings runs depends on the product doing what we told agents and clients it would do. This role is how we know it does. It is also how a small team operates at national scale: by letting AI run the work that used to take people, and freeing leadership to focus on where the product and the MLS landscape go next.

**At Compass You Will**
-----------------------

### **Inventory Product Testing & Validation**

* Own day-to-day execution of QA testing and quality validation (including secret shopping) for inventory products across the MLS, agent platform, brand websites, and portals
* Build and maintain standard testing practices: test plans, scenario libraries, pass/fail criteria, defect severity levels, and readout templates, so every test runs the same way no matter who runs it
* Coordinate offshore testing teams: scope the work, write clear test instructions, set turnaround expectations, and review output against a quality bar
* Partner with Product and Engineering as new features approach release; read requirements, map the scenarios and edge cases that need coverage (by brand, market, MLS rule set, listing status, and seller instruction), and get tests designed before launch rather than after
* Organize test readouts: synthesize results, prioritize defects by business impact, and bring a clear recommendation to the Director, Product, and brand stakeholders
* Track defects to resolution and confirm fixes in production through regression testing
* Apply AI to testing itself, from generating scenario coverage off a requirements doc to automating repeatable checks and secret shopping
* Support technical readiness for new launches by validating that products work as expected before they reach agents

### **Documentation, Tracking & Organization**

* Be the team's system of record: keep test plans, results, defects, automations, SOPs, and decisions documented, current, and easy to find
* Build and maintain the trackers the team runs on (testing cycles, automation builds, open issues, requests, and cross-functional commitments) so status is always visible without anyone having to ask
* Organize every cross-functional interaction with Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, offshore teams, and brand stakeholders: notes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates, with follow-through until each item is closed
* Document every automation so others can understand, audit, maintain, and improve it
* Keep a clean record of product behavior, known issues, and MLS rule interpretations so answers never live in one person's head
* Set documentation and tracking standards for the team, so the Director and partners can get full context fast

### **AI Automation & Process Rebuild**

* Help build, test, and deploy AI automations for the processes the Director and team have prioritized, so AI owns the work end to end and people review exceptions
* Prototype quickly by vibe coding, then stress test before anything goes live: edge cases, bad inputs, volume, and failure scenarios
* Harden prototypes into systems that run daily in production, not one-off scripts or personal tools
* Set up monitoring for each automation: expected outputs, accuracy checks, error handling, alerting, and a clear escalation path when something fails
* Measure each automation's impact in hours returned, error rates, and turnaround time
* Build governance in from the start: partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Security so every automation respects MLS data licensing terms, seller privacy and instructions, and Fair Housing requirements, and keeps an audit trail of what it did
* Train support, brand-facing, and operations teams on each new workflow before it launches, with walkthroughs, quick-reference guides, and office hours
* Manage the change from manual to automated work: define who reviews exceptions, retire old processes cleanly, and track adoption and feedback until the new workflow sticks, partnering with the enablement team when a change reaches agents

### **Reporting, Data & Validation**

* Partner with Data & Analytics to define reporting requirements for inventory products and programs, with consistent metric definitions across teams
* Test and validate report and dashboard outputs before they are used for decisions, and trace discrepancies between systems (MLS feeds, agent platform, brand websites, portals) to root cause
