jobs.title: Technology Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**  
  
Do you want to help executives navigate technology disruption at a scale and speed they've never faced before? Are you the kind of person who sees a hard problem and leans in instead of looking away? You're exactly who we're looking for.  
  
AI is reshaping industries overnight. Global markets are shifting faster than playbooks can keep up. Entire business models are being rewritten in real time. For the leaders steering through it, this isn't a moment for more of the same... it's a moment that demands fresh thinking, bold moves, and partners who can see around corners. There has never been a more exciting time to be a strategic advisor - join us for this moment!  
  
**Is this You?**  
  
You're drawn to hard problems, not easy answers. You vibe code for fun. You're curious about how technology is disrupting an industry at a rapid pace before it ever makes the news. You read about a company making a bold strategic bet and find yourself thinking about what drove the decision, and how to execute that vision.  
  
You don't need to have it all figured out yet or arrive as a technology expert. But you learn quickly, care about creating value for organizations, not just how a plan might read on a page. You're sharp enough to find the signal in messy data. You're genuinely excited about AI, not as a buzzword, but as something you want to learn to use responsibly, for both delivery transformation and as an enabler, in high-stakes situations. And you're ambitious enough to want your work to matter starting now, not eventually.  
  
If you want to become the kind of advisor executives trust with their hardest decisions, it **starts at Deloitte as an Enterprise Tech Strategy Analyst.**  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
Your work will feed the decisions executives can't afford to get wrong. Here's what that looks like day to day: you'll get a problem that isn't fully defined, and part of your job is figuring out the right question before you can even get to an answer. You'll dig into data, build the analysis, and find the insight that changes how a client sees their situation; you'll be exposed to the latest AI tools and accelerators. You will learn to communicate your recommendation clearly to Executives who've been running companies longer than you've been in the workforce.  
  
The questions you will wrestle with sit at the center of enterprise transformation:  

* What target technology state will enable the company's strategy?
* Which platforms, data, and AI capabilities should be modernized, and in what sequence?
* How should cloud, architecture, cyber, and product or platform operating models evolve?
* Where can AI create differentiated value, and how can it be scaled responsibly?
* How should leaders address technology debt, investment tradeoffs, and the change required to activate the roadmap?

  
These are a few illustrative questions our clients are asking...and that you will address as part of our team! The work spans the full arc of strategic advising: diagnosing where a business stands, charting where it needs to go, shaping the modernization roadmap, designing the transformation required to get there, and even staying with the business to turn the solution on! You'll be expected to think, not just execute, and to bring a perspective into every conversation.  
  
The best strategies aren't measured by the quality of the deck, they're road-tested and measured by the value at scale that they create. Strategy and execution aren't separate disciplines. As an Enterprise Tech Strategy Analyst at Deloitte, you'll learn how to connect the two.  
  
**Required Qualifications**  

* Must be currently enrolled in an accredited college or university and expected to graduate by Spring/Summer 2027 pursuing a bachelor's degree or higher in one of the following majors or a related/equivalent program

* Info Systems
* Business
* Economics
* Engineering
* Computer Science
* Accounting
* Operations
* Supply Chain
* Liberal Arts
* Strong academic track record (3.3 cumulative GPA required, 3.5 cumulative GPA preferred).
* Must live within a commutable distance to your assigned office (g. 100-mile radius) with the ability to commute daily, ifrequired, uponstartdate
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future  

  
  
This is an entry-level opportunity intended for candidates interested in beginning or building a career in this field. We welcome applicants from a range of educational and professional backgrounds who meet the qualifications for the role. For roles that require a year or more of work experience, please review the experienced jobs within our careers site.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900 to $147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

**Become a part of our caring community**

The Data Protection Security Investigations Analyst 2 works with EIP stakeholders and Humana’s teams to identify high risk insider activity and ensure appropriate controls are in place to mitigate potential data loss or malicious activity. * Meet established service levels, maintain complete and accurate case records, reduce avoidable queue aging, and escalate blockers or emerging risk promptly.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Two or more years of relevant technical experience, including at least one year in Data Security, Cyber Data Protection, DLP, security operations, insider risk, incident response support, or a related field.
* Experience triaging security alerts, reviewing logs, collecting evidence, documenting findings, and supporting investigations or incident response.
* Working knowledge of DLP, data classification, information protection, security monitoring, data handling, and common exposure scenarios.
* Ability to analyze routine to moderately complex issues, follow established procedures, and make sound, evidence-based recommendations.
* Experience supporting centralized intake, ticket handling, case management, or operational queues with consistent prioritization and follow-up.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills for explaining Data Security controls to technical and business stakeholders.
* Commitment to accurate documentation and continuous improvement of scalable, efficient workflows.
* Ability to responsibly use approved AI-enabled tools to improve investigation efficiency, documentation quality, process consistency, and decision support while protecting sensitive information and complying with security, privacy, legal, and regulatory requ

NYS Homes and Community Renewal (HCR) is committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility. Our work would not be possible without the diverse backgrounds, experiences, ideas, and abilities of our employees. HCR is committed to developing a workforce that represents the diverse population of New York State. HCR embraces a diverse and inclusive work environment by encouraging all individuals, including those with disabilities, to apply to open positions at the agency.

Resilient Homes and Communities (RHC) now serves as the lead principal office responsible for the administration of New York State’s multiple CDBG-DR awards. RHC operates within the New York State Housing Trust Fund Corporation (HTFC) and the Homeownership and Community Development (HOCD) unit, which consists of the State of New York Mortgage Agency, the Affordable Housing Corporation, the Office of Community Renewal, the Office of Special Initiatives and RHC.

**Position Summary**

The Data Analyst will play a key supporting role analyzing, visualizing and reporting data for the Office of Resilient Homes and Communities. This position combines data science, spatial data analysis (GIS) with business and policy research to support reporting, decision-making, and program quality across the agency. Reporting to the Director of Research and Data, the Data Analyst will assist in maintaining spatial and quantitative databases, updating the federal Disaster Recovery Grants Reporting (DRGR) system, and producing maps, dashboards, and reports. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to gain hands-on experience in disaster recovery policy, data integrity, and public sector data analysis.

**Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* **Data & Reporting Support:** Assist in the development, update, and maintenance of performance management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc data analyses to support program operations.
* **GIS & Spatial Analysis:** Support program teams by maintaining Esri ArcGIS software/ArcGIS Online platforms, performing basic spatial analyses, and creating maps and graphs for internal and external stakeholders.
* **System Maintenance:** Help input, track, and verify service areas and program data within New York State’s internal systems and the federal Disaster Recovery Grant Reporting (DRGR) system to ensure accuracy across program records.
* **Data Quality & Documentation:** Assist in documenting data methodologies, maintaining Standards of Procedure (SOPs) for federal reporting, and performing routine data cleaning and quality control.
* **Research Assistance:** Provide analytical and research support for ongoing projects evaluating the impact of RHC programs on New York State residents.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate with internal program teams and external partners to share, transfer, and package data for reporting and research needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field\*
* Knowledge of public policy in areas such as disaster recovery, infrastructure, housing, economic development, and/or resiliency is preferred.
* Experience distilling quantitative and qualitative policy analysis into written descriptions such as briefs, memos, etc.
* 2 years professional experience in an analytic role\*
* Demonstrated experience using Esri ArcGIS 10.x, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, Model Builder, R and basic python programming.
* Excellent oral, written, and quantitative skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional ability to use data to make decisions.
* Expertise in the use of Microsoft Office products, specifically Excel and Access.
* Ability to work in a flexible, fast paced, mission driven environment.
* *Substitutions: four years of specialized experience or associate’s degree and two years of specialized experience may substitute for bachelor’s degree; J.D. or master’s degree may substitute for one year of specialized experience; Ph.D. may substitute for two years of specialized experience.*

*This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned.*

**APPLICANTS MUST INCLUDE A RESUME**

**WHAT WE OFFER AT NYS HCR:**

* Extensive benefits package including participation in New York State’s Health Insurance Program and New York State & Local Employees’ Retirement System.
* Promotional opportunities for dedicated professionals.
* Work-life balance benefits including a 37.5-hour work week, opportunity for compressed scheduling, and paid time off benefits (vacation, sick, personal days, and federal holidays).
* 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave.

jobs.title: Climate and Soil Health Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

Reporting to the National Climate and Soil Health Deputy Director and Scientist, the Climate and Soil Health Program Manager supports AFT’s Climate and Soil Health Program by providing operational leadership for key priorities, managing outreach, communications, and stakeholder engagement, coordinating cross-functional implementation activities, and ensuring and contributing to delivery of funded project outcomes. The position supports AFT’s efforts to catalyze a new conventional agriculture: empowering farmers and ranchers across the nation’s diverse systems to achieve on-farm and societal benefits from systems that are soil health promoting, biodiverse, climate-neutral or better, resilient, equitable, and environmentally, economically, and socially sustainable.

**Position Summary**

As an integral part of the National Climate and Soil Health Program, the Climate and Soil Health Program Manager leads program outreach and metrics tracking, manages the roll out and maintenance of the virtual network platform, and manages communications, stakeholder engagement, resource dissemination, and other operational priorities that support successful delivery across the Climate and Soil Health Portfolio. The position collaborates across projects and teams to develop outreach and educational resources and events, facilitate partner engagement, support financial management and funder and impact reporting, and ensure that key tasks, deliverables, and communications move efficiently from planning to completion to facilitate successful and timely award and program outcomes. The Program Manager supports the Director, Deputy, and broader team by contributing to identification of implementation needs, addressing operational challenges, and contributing to the continued evolution of Climate and Soil Health programming strategies.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Programmatic management and support**

* Manage select partners, stakeholders, and AFT staff to achieve goals and deliverables set forth by the National Climate and Soil Health Program’s funders and other AFT teams as applicable;
* Lead, support and ensure successful implementation of assigned workstreams and deliverables for Climate and Soil Health related projects;
* Coordinate and contribute to the collection, documentation, organization, tracking, and reporting to funders of project outcomes, metrics, partner contributions, and deliverables.
* Lead and support outreach, communications, educational programming, producer engagement, and dissemination activities, including collaboration with internal and external partners to implement communications and engagement plans.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners, bridging across soil scientists, economists, farmers, on-the-ground technical assistants, suppliers and food companies, program managers, ag specialists and other contributors, to coordinate on-farm demonstration trials, implementation activities, information flow, resource creation, trainings, networks, and other project deliverables that support farmers in trialing, adopting, and/or continuing to use environmentally and economically sound practices or marketing their products with sustainability premiums and environmental services.
* Coordinate, contribute to, and support the development, review, publication, and dissemination, of science-based project resources, such as website content, outreach materials and plans, curricula, trainings, presentations, factsheets, farmer reports, public-facing reports, white papers, decision support tools, and peer-reviewed manuscripts, that support adoption of soil health practices and facilitate overall improvements in climate and soil health outcomes.
* Represent AFT at occasional project-related events, such as conferences, trainings, and meetings;
* Build, facilitate, and manage the Climate and Soil Health Program virtual network microsites within the greater AFT Higher Logic program.
* Coordinate and support development of external advisory committee to support improved feedback loops and project outcomes, particularly on improved market access for producers using environmentally and economically sound practices.

**Stakeholder, partnership and collaboration management for impact:**

* Support and operationally manage Climate and Soil Health Program’s external partnership development with a diverse network of agricultural and conservation professionals and funders, including NRCS, Soil and Water Conservation Districts, Land Grant University Extensions, Industry, farmers, crop consultants and others relevant to implementation of project workstreams and for achieving project outcomes.
* Engage staff and stakeholders in identifying barriers to programmatic goals and funder deliverables, and work collaboratively to develop resounding solutions;
* Support and facilitate culture of shared learning, team creativity and problem solving for public benefits across a diverse, interdisciplinary, collaborative, mutually supportive national team.
* Serve as AFT representative for cross-organizational endeavors and events.

**Work plan, budget and fundraising management support**

* Support Director, Deputy, and Project Managers to map out and steward funding, personnel resources, workplans, budgets, and timelines of currently funded Advancing Markets for Producers (AMP) and Conservation Innovation Grant (CIG) and other project workstreams, as well as for the development of future programmatic areas and funding of the Climate & Soil Health Program, for achieving high quality, timely current and future project outcomes.
* Support development of partnerships and outreach approaches that expand access to Climate and Soil Health programming for diverse agricultural communities.
* Assist the Deputy Director in carrying out administrative and financial tasks, such as invoicing, contract review, partner payments, and ensuring necessary documentation is complete as necessary for partnerships,

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

Noblis ESI is seeking an experienced **Data Analyst** with a focus on data visualization, strategic analytics, and AI-enhanced delivery to join our team on-site in Chantilly, VA.

The Data Analyst will design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards for our IC customer and Directorate Leadership, Office Chiefs and project managers. Working directly with the Directorate's Strategy and Knowledge Management teams, the candidate will synthesize data from diverse sources—including Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, spreadsheets, briefings, and presentations—into actionable visualizations that inform Senior Leadership on cross-enterprise coordination and resourcing decisions. AI and automation technologies will be leveraged to accelerate dashboard development and improve the speed and quality of data-driven insights delivered to decision-makers.

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Design, build, and maintain executive-level dashboards using Tableau, HTML/web-based solutions, Jira dashboards, and other visualization tools to support Directorate and IC senior leadership decisions.
* Establish and maintain data pipelines connecting diverse sources—Jira REST API, Confluence, SharePoint, and other enterprise platforms—to visualization tools, ensuring reliable, secure, and timely data access.
* Leverage AI and machine learning technologies (e.g., LLMs, NLP, generative AI, predictive analytics) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and enhance visualization delivery.
* Collect, curate, and integrate data from structured and unstructured sources including Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, briefings, presentations, and other enterprise repositories.
* Collaborate with the MID Strategy team and stakeholders to elicit reporting requirements, define key performance indicators (KPIs), and translate strategic questions into visualization solutions tailored to the appropriate tool, delivery format, and audience.
* Analyze operational and programmatic datasets to uncover trends and insights supporting enterprise planning and resource allocation.
* Evaluate, recommend, and prototype new visualization tools and AI-enabled analytics capabilities to continuously improve decision-support products.
* Develop standardized data taxonomies and naming conventions to ensure consistent and accurate reporting across MID.
* Conduct data validation and quality assurance across all ingested data sources to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of dashboard outputs.
* Present data-driven findings and dashboard walkthroughs to senior leadership, translating technical analytics into executive-level narratives.
* Maintain a professional appearance and polished presentation standard for all dashboard deliverables and visualization products shared with MID and NRO Senior Leadership audiences.

* Degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analysis, or related field.
* Mastery of data visualization and data manipulation skills, including Tableau (Desktop, Server, and/or Cloud) dashboard design, calculated fields, parameters, LOD expressions, and data source management.
* Experience with multiple data visualization approaches, including web-based dashboards (HTML/CSS/JavaScript), Jira dashboards, and/or other BI platforms.
* Mastery connecting visualization tools to REST APIs and diverse data sources (Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, relational databases).
* Strong querying and data manipulation skills, proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, and preparation across multiple data stores.
* Experience with Python for data analysis, API scripting, automation, and AI/ML integration.
* Demonstrated ability to design and deliver executive-level visualizations that meet a professional appearance standard for non-technical senior leadership audiences.
* Experience defining and tracking KPIs, metrics, and performance indicators in support of strategic decision-making.
* Experience or knowledge applying AI technologies (e.g., LLMs, NLP, generative AI, predictive models) to enhance analytical workflows or accelerate data product delivery.
* Have an eye for design, color palette, and layout of information. UI/UX experience and an understanding of the audience, the information they need, and the decisions they are able to make with the data/dashboards.
* Statistical literacy, understanding of distributions, variance, and outliers, correlation vs. causation, data quality and bias issues, etc.
* Strong understanding of data quality principles, data governance, and data classification/taxonomy development.

* Lift up to 30 lbs, walk, bend, drive.

Desired Qualifications:

* Experience with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence—REST APIs, JQL, administration, custom fields, workflows) in support of Knowledge Management Team operations and for NRO Leadership/Directorate audiences.
* Ability to transform data into engaging and informative visualizations that clearly explain key trends to stakeholders and executives.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Work Where it Matters**

Akima Mission Optimization (AMO), an Akima company, is not just another federal logistics contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At AMO, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

**For our shareholders**, AMO provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

**For our government customers**, AMO delivers innovative administrative support services that streamline operations, and enhance productivity.

**As an AMO employee**, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

Description:

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support complex data analysis, operations research, software integration and testing, and advanced analytics in support of mission and program objectives. This position will apply statistical, mathematical, programming, and data science techniques to collect, process, analyze, and interpret complex datasets. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

The Data Analyst will work with a variety of data sources and technologies, including structured and unstructured data, SQL and NoSQL databases, APIs, ETL pipelines, search indexes, and analytical programming tools. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with operations research, data science, statistical analysis, and programming languages such as Python and R.

Responsibilities:

* Perform data analysis, data mining, statistical analysis, and operations research to support program and mission objectives.
* Apply complex mathematical and statistical concepts to analyze data, identify trends and relationships, and develop actionable insights.
* Develop and execute analytical methodologies, models, and techniques to support data-driven decision-making.
* Perform software integration and testing activities, including analyzing, developing, and implementing test plans and test scripts.
* Use scripting and programming languages, including Python and R, to conduct data analysis and advanced analytics.
* Utilize commonly used data science and analytics packages and tools, including Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, NumPy, Requests, and related technologies.
* Apply data science, data mining, statistical, and graph-based algorithms to support analytical objectives.
* Develop and utilize Structured Query Language (SQL) and NoSQL technologies to access, manipulate, and analyze data.
* Support Application Programming Interface (API) development and integration to facilitate data access and exchange.
* Develop, maintain, and utilize Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) pipelines to collect, process, transform, and prepare data for analysis.
* Work with web application servers, search indexes, databases, and other data management technologies.
* Analyze and integrate data from multiple sources to support complex analytical requirements.
* Apply statistical and operations research methods, tools, and techniques to solve complex analytical problems.
* Use spreadsheets and other analytical tools for data manipulation, analysis, visualization, and reporting.
* Develop data visualizations and analytical products to communicate findings and support mission requirements.
* Conduct data validation and quality checks to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of analytical results.
* Document analytical methodologies, processes, findings, and results.
* Collaborate with technical teams, analysts, program managers, and other stakeholders to identify data requirements and develop effective analytical solutions.
* Support continuous improvement of data analysis processes, tools, methodologies, and technical solutions.

Qualifications:

* Master’s degree in a related field is desired.
* A Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) may be substituted for the Master’s degree with an additional five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
* Ten (10) years of experience in operations research is desired.
* Demonstrated experience applying statistical, mathematical, analytical, and operations research methods to complex problems.
* Experience with data science, data mining, advanced analytics, or statistical analysis.
* Experience with software integration and/or testing, including the development or implementation of test plans and scripts.
* Experience using scripting or programming languages such as Python and R.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, APIs, ETL pipelines, or related data technologies.
* Experience working with data science and analytical tools such as Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, NumPy, or similar technologies.
* Strong analytical, mathematical, statistical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work with complex datasets and translate analytical findings into meaningful conclusions and recommendations.
* Ability to use spreadsheets and other analytical tools for data manipulation, visualization, and reporting.
* Active Top Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant industry certification in data science, cloud computing, cybersecurity, database technologies, or related technical disciplines.
* Experience with big data, advanced analytics, machine learning, or graph algorithms.
* Experience developing or supporting APIs, ETL pipelines, search indexes, or web application environments.
* Experience supporting U.S. Government or Department of Defense

**WE ARE THE NRO**  
For sixty years, the NRO has developed, acquired, launched and operated the satellites that are the foundation for America's advantage and strength in space. Using a diversified architecture of spacecraft, NRO collects and delivers the best space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance content on the planet.  
Learn more at NRO.gov.  
  
**Basic Eligibility For A Position With The NRO**

* You will be subject to pre-employment and periodic drug testing
* You will be subject to pre-employment and periodic polygraph examinations

  
**Where You Will Work**  
The Advanced Systems and Technology (AS&T) Directorate is responsible for discovering, researching, developing, and transitioning revolutionary and innovative technologies to the rest of organization. We have an exciting opportunity for a high performing individual to serve as the Technology Transition & Transfer (T3) Program Manager. Tech Transfer plays a critical role in discovering, on-boarding, and transitioning technology from non-traditional partners across industry, academia, and other government agencies. This position supports NRO's Federal Laboratory, the Space Reconnaissance Lab (SRL).  
The NRO Cadre is collecting resumes for consideration against current and future opportunities for **Non-Supervisor, Technology Transition and Transfer Dept PM, GGS 12-13, occupational series 0801**. More information on the occupational series can be viewed on the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) website.

**Who May Apply**

* This position is open to the public.
* Federal government employees MUST currently be at the grade level or higher as indicated in this announcement. This is NOT a promotion opportunity for current Federal government employees. If selected for the position, Federal government employees will transition laterally at their current grade level and step.
* Federal applicants who exceed the advertised grade may voluntarily request acceptance at the lower grade per IAW DoW 1400.25 Volume 2006.

As PM, you will have the opportunity to oversee or participate in contract acquisitions, both FAR and non-FAR based, and may serve as a Contracting Officer’s Technical Representative (COTR) for acquisition and research and development projects to advance current and future intelligence needs.  
The successful candidate will be responsible for one or more programs that comprise multiple research projects. Examples of research areas in include: Autonomy, Data Transport, Remote Sensing, Resiliency & Security, and Foundation Technology. The candidate should have excellent leadership, collaboration, and communication skills, and be willing to engage organizations throughout the Government, academia, and industry. You will be involved in shaping how NRO plans for future technology, research, and development.  
  
**What You Will Need**  
REQUIRED:

* Documented ability to build partnerships across an organization
* Documented ability to lead change and innovation within an organization
* Demonstrated leadership and technical skills.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager (NSGS)

This position will be located in Alexandria, VA and will be a hybrid position.

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will serve as the primary leader responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex IT infrastructure and enterprise network projects to ensure USCG mission success. You will coordinate closely with USCG stakeholders, cross-functional engineering teams, field technicians, and vendor partners to ensure smooth technology upgrades with minimal operational disruption. jobs.description:
Defense Critical Infrastructure All-Source Intelligence Analyst

**The Opportunity:**

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security.

As a Defense Critical Infrastructure All-Source Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission environment. You'll work with interagency teams to determine threats to DoD critical infrastructure, providing executive clients with threat briefings and mitigation opportunities. This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our policymakers.

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**MANTECH** seeks a motivated, career- and customer-oriented **Jr Data Analyst** to join our innovative team in **Ashburn, VA**. This is a part time hybrid position with 2-3 days onsite a week.

Each day U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) oversees the massive flow of people, capital, and products that enter and depart the United States via air, land, sea, and cyberspace. The volume and complexity of both physical and virtual border crossings require the application of “big data” solutions to promote efficient trade and travel. These solutions provide CBP personnel with additional tools to evaluate potential threats from legitimate trade and travel.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Help maintain existing dashboards and generate recurring reports under the guidance of senior analysts.
* Perform basic data validation and cleaning tasks to ensure accuracy and consistency in reporting.
* Assist in documenting data sources, query logic, and reporting processes to ensure team knowledge sharing.
* Identify, review, and evaluate large volumes of sensitive and complex intelligence data pertaining to CBP initiatives.
* Collaborate with intel analysts, enterprise/application architects, database architects, data scientists, and mission stakeholders.
* Work closely with team members to understand data requirements and provide support for ad-hoc requests and actively participate in training and mentorship opportunities to build proficiency in agency data tools and methodologies.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* AS and 4-13 years or BS and 2+ years or MS and 0-5 years or PHD and 0-3 years in Data Science, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Statistics or Mathematics.
* Coursework related and/or prior internship related to data analytics.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and a strong interest in data management. Familiarity with Excel (including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs) is required.
* Basic understanding of scripting languages (e.g., Python or R).
* Strong problem-solving skills and a high level of attention to detail.
* Ability to follow technical instructions and communicate progress clearly to team members.
* A proactive attitude toward learning new software, tools, and agency-specific data protocols.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Understanding of software engineering best practices (Git, CI/CD).
* Experience working in law enforcement or classified intelligence analysis environment.
* Experience working within an Agile development environment.

**Clearance Requirements:**

* Must be a U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain DHS CBP suitability prior to starting this position.

**Physical Requirements:**

* The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, or to communicate with coworkers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations.

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco is excited to continue our support to the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office. This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst**, located in Crystal City, Arlington, VA, supports the F-35 JPO Future Capability & Technology (FCAT) Directorate in its mission in achieving Kill-Chain dominance through Intelligence, robust Operational Analysis (OA), requirements integration and analysis, and Research and Technology exploration, for all elements of the F-35 Air System. Our Program Analyst supports FCAT in leading, identifying, maturing, informing, and transitioning capability candidate nominations and integration planning for insertion into the F-35 Air System Program of Record (PoR), to and on behalf of the U.S. Services and International Partner countries.

Our Program Analysts review and evaluate business systems and user needs. Formulates systems to parallel overall business strategies. Write detailed descriptions of user needs, program functions, and steps required to develop or modify computer programs. Familiar with relational database concepts, and client-server concepts. Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Performs a variety of complicated tasks. May lead and direct the work of others. May report directly to a project lead or manager. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.

**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer an active DoD Secret security clearance.**

In this role, you will:

* Intelligence – Assist FCAT in providing all intelligence support required across the three Intel pillars of Threat, Intel Supportability Analysis (SA), and Intel Disclosure/Release by supporting every aspect of the program. Assist FCAT in serving as the designated liaison between the Program and the Services and Intel community; providing constantly updated current and forecast threat information to stakeholders to drive requirements and engineering analysis.
* Assist FCAT in ensuring all intelligence equities involved with fielding and exporting F-35 (e.g., intelligence mission data) are defined, engineered, and sustained.
* Air System Requirements Assessment, Development, and Approval in collaboration with External Stakeholders. Assist FCAT in managing the Pre-PoR F-35 Air System Requirements and in creating, maintaining, and promulgating a comprehensive Roadmap to inform the PMOs of risks and opportunities for the F-35 Program.
* Assist FCAT in developing the F-35 Flight Plan which provides an integrated strategy for F-35 capabilities focusing on Participant’s future requirements over the next five to ten years and ensuring warfighter capability need dates are being clearly communicated to the PoR activities within the JPO. Assist FCAT in maturing and recommending for approval all new F-35 requirements, developing the Flight Plan and New Capabilities Decision Memoranda.
* Research and Technology (R&T) – assist FCAT in researching and assisting in development of technology through discovery, sponsorship, candidate studies and analysis, maturation, prototyping, experimentation, demonstration, and transition for relevant technology solutions for consideration and prioritization to transition into the F-35 PoR.
* Strategic Acquisition and Transition Planning (SATP) – assist FCAT in developing strategy for incorporating capability requirements defined by the Air Systems Requirements (ASR) team and technology developed by the R&T team into an acquisition program that is ready to be incorporated into the PoR and transitioned to the PMOs for execution.
* Program Strategy – assist FCAT in integrating research and emerging policy in National Defense Strategy, global geo-political domains, warfighting tactics, operations, kill chain, applied technology domain, global business, and market practices into F-35 JPO Program Strategy as well as in providing effective coaching and maintains strategic dialogue with JPO and external stakeholders.
* Governance Structure – assist FCAT in leading Requirements Working Group (RWG), Operational Advisory Group (OAG), Senior Warfighter Group (SWG), JSF (Joint Strike Fighter) Executive Steering Board (JESB) and in assisting with Configuration Steering Board (CSB) and requirements portion of the U.S. Executive Steering Group.
* Transfer requirements from the FCAT to the PoR – assist FCAT in providing applicable acquisition documentation and planning materials to the PMOs for execution, in collaboration with the PMOs.

  

To be successful in this role, you must have:

**Are you ready to take your career to the next level? We are seeking skilled and motivated Intel Professionals to join our team.**

  

**Position Summary:**

**HII: Mission Technologies** is seeking a qualified and experienced Defensive Counterintelligence (DCI) Analyst to support its customer on the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Division of Strategic Information (DSI) program in Woodlawn, Maryland. This is a full-time hybrid role, and up to 10% travel may be required. This is an opportunity to apply your expertise to meaningful governance and counterintelligence work.

  

**Come support our work with CMS/HHS and join a high-performing team of engineers!**

----------------------------------

* Offer cybersecurity expertise to the CMS DCI team and coordinate with the Security Operations Center (SOC) on counterintelligence incidents
* Examine, evaluate, and maintain ongoing oversight of cyber-affiliated inquiries

jobs.description:
**Start Your Adventure at Via Logic**
-------------------------------------

**Location:** Onsite at a government site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area  
**Type:** Full-time, W-2  
**Compensation:** $80,000–$130,000 annually, depending on experience and assignment  
**Experience:** Approximately 1–5 years of relevant experience; we are considering candidates across multiple experience levels

**Eligibility & Clearance Requirements**
----------------------------------------

Due to CBP contract requirements, applicants must:

* Be a U.S. citizen.
* Meet CBP suitability requirements for access to government facilities and systems.
* Meet any clearance requirements for the specific assignment. Some openings may require a Secret or Top Secret clearance; certain specialized assignments may also require SCI eligibility. We will confirm the requirement for each role.

One posting, several possible routes. We are hiring for multiple openings at different experience levels, which is why the experience and salary ranges are broad. Depending on the assignment, you could work in security monitoring, threat analysis, incident response, investigations, or vulnerability assessment. We will match your strengths to the role that fits.

**Your Mission**
----------------

* Analyze security alerts, logs, events, and other data to identify suspicious activity and assess its impact.
* Investigate potential incidents, document findings, and help teams determine appropriate escalation and response.
* Support vulnerability analysis, threat intelligence, or proactive threat hunting where aligned with your skills.
* Collaborate with engineers, incident responders, system owners, and other stakeholders to resolve findings and strengthen defenses.
* Maintain clear case notes, reports, procedures, and recommendations that others can act on.

**What You Bring to the Expedition**
------------------------------------

* Approximately 1–5 years of experience in security operations, cyber analysis, incident response, investigations, vulnerability assessment, or a related discipline.
* Experience interpreting alerts and logs, researching potential threats, and explaining findings clearly.
* Familiarity with security monitoring or investigation tools, such as SIEM, endpoint detection, vulnerability scanning, or threat intelligence platforms.
* Sound judgment about when to investigate further, escalate, or involve another technical team.
* Ability to work onsite in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

Experience with detection rules, network traffic analysis, digital evidence, insider threat monitoring, or penetration testing is welcome. We will match candidates to openings based on the depth of their experience in those areas.

**Your Route Into Via Logic**
-----------------------------

We are hiring across several openings and experience levels through this posting. Tell us which security disciplines you have worked in, the tools you have used, and your current clearance status so we can identify the best fit.

**Why Explorers Stay**
----------------------

* Healthcare coverage and paid time off that give you room to take care of life outside work.
* Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help each other grow.
* Opportunities to deepen your specialty and explore adjacent areas of cybersecurity as new assignments open up.
* Meaningful work protecting systems that support a federal mission.

**How We Work**
---------------

* These positions work onsite at a government site in the Washington, DC metropolitan area. The specific site depends on the assignment.
* You'll collaborate with Via Logic teammates, government partners, and other technical teams using tools approved for your work environment.
* Schedules depend on the assignment. Some teams work daytime Eastern Time hours; others may have shift or on-call requirements. We'll discuss the schedule for a specific opening before moving forward.
* When virtual meetings are part of the work, we expect active participation and use video when appropriate and permitted by the client environment.

**About Via Logic**
-------------------

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Flow Management Data & Services (FMDS)
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**Shape the Future of America’s Skies with Peraton**

  

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s **Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS)** contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton delivers the mission-critical systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe, secure, and connected.

  

We’re seeking innovative professionals who thrive in high-impact, mission-driven environments and are excited to help transform the future of air traffic management. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures while collaborating with leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

  

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission—you’ll help define it.

  

**Location:** This position is onsite in Herndon, VA.

  

**Program Overview:**

  

The Flow Management Data & Services (FMDS) is a next-generation FAA program designed to replace the Traffic Flow Management System (TFMS) through Release 16 and beyond. FMDS provides a streamlined, modernized experience for the full array of FAA internal and external users, establishing a common model of National Airspace System (NAS) operations and a foundation to achieve future FAA goals.

  

FMDS core functions include:

* \*\*Manage Data\*\* – Ingests and processes external data sources including flight, weather, aeronautical, Collaborative Decision Making (CDM), and space data to create a common operational model of the NAS. Supports derivation of additional data (e.g., modeled trajectories, weather analysis) and provision of data to FMDS services and external automation.
* \*\*Assess NAS State\*\* – Evaluates current and projected NAS conditions, enabling Traffic Managers to identify near- and long-term problems and determine whether mitigating actions are required.

jobs.description:

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Reston, VA, USA; Washington D.C., DC, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in technical program management or technical leadership roles, including leading cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in the U.S. Government within the last 6 months, specifically in the Intelligence Community (IC) and Defense, including experience in technical leadership roles.
* Experience delivering digital implementation projects to national security and defense organizations.
* Must possess an active Top Secret/SCI security clearance with current polygraph.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 20% of the time.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Certification in Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) or Project Management Professional (PMP).
* 10 years of experience managing complex cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience managing professional services teams, encompassing practice management, operations, methodology, business development, pre-business, executive relationship management, and engagement delivery.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

In this role, you will utilize your technical expertise and leadership skills to drive end-to-end delivery of complex technical programs as an individual contributor. Your primary mission is to securely deploy Google technology, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP), to drive mission value in large, multi-year transformational engagements for National Security and Defense customers.

You will lead complex technical program portfolios, providing delivery leadership and strategic technical consulting that exceeds customer expectations. This includes executive relationship management, pre-sales scoping, technical requirements gathering, risk mitigation, and program scheduling. You will collaborate closely with Google’s sales, cross-functional executives, and technical leaders to oversee solution deployment, including leveraging our exceptional security resources to protect customers.

Google Public Sector brings the magic of Google to the mission of government and education with solutions purpose-built for enterprises. We focus on helping United States public sector institutions accelerate their digital transformations, and we continue to make significant investments and grow our team to meet the complex needs of local, state and federal government and educational institutions.

  
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive execution in undefined problem spaces by taking vague business requirements and structuring them into actionable technical execution plans.
* Use industry domain knowledge, provide leadership and influence in customer pursuits and deployments.
* Act as a technical thought leader to influence cross-functional teams (e.g., AI, Security, Cloud, Product, and Engineering) and manage dependencies, alignment, and stakeholder management without direct authority.
* Lead pre-sales scoping engagements for seamless transition into delivery. Be a change advocate responsible for initiating and leading the deployment of Google AI and Security solutions to customers and partners.
* Lead portfolio reviews, technical decision-making, and prioritization across technical initiatives, while balancing quality, customer impact, and financial metrics.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:

Category: Business Systems/Analysis

widget: Full-Time

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program.

Our Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Policy Analyst (FMS Program Analyst), Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.

You will be part of a dynamic team of F-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F-35 systems.

In this role, you will:

* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105.65-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* The ability to provide onsite support at the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
  + OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105.38-MX.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Center Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Data Center Design Engineering team.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The ideal candidate should thrive in ambiguity and competing priorities. Be an exceptionally strong communicator both written and verbally who can translate complex technical schedules into clear executive narratives. Possess a strong sense of organization, accountability, and team building that fosters robust working relationships across internal and external stakeholders. Are comfortable managing remote delivery teams and can navigate mechanical/electrical engineering concepts with confidence. Are relentless about on-time delivery and treat every missed milestone as a learning opportunity to improve the system.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical mechanical, electrical and utility needs for the business today and in the future
* Utilize those insights to identify specific program requirements, create a program vision, and own the product development roadmap for critical segments of the data center physical infrastructure
* Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
* Drive continuous advancements and improvements within our data center designs, and communicate technical solutions to Senior Management
* Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide scale deployment to eventual deprecation
* Develop product features and deployment strategies to improve performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency of new applications and use cases
* Communicate complex issues clearly and effectively to leadership to propose solutions and fully inform risk decisions
* Work independently in a high-performing environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

  
About the team  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience managing data center and/or mission critical facility design projects
* 5+ years of data center infrastructure experience including capacity planning, design, construction, or operations

jobs.title: Technical Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

Markon is seeking a Technical Operations Project Manager to support an Intelligence Community client in Chantilly, Virginia. The Technical Operations PM will serve as the primary technical point of contact for the Project Team, providing technical guidance, coordinating requirements, and overseeing solutions as customer communications needs evolve.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for a designated Project Team and its communications solution suite.
* Manage and track customer technical solutions throughout the lifecycle, from requirements gathering and development through implementation and operations and maintenance (O&M).
* Gather and document technical requirements and coordinate them with customers, stakeholders, and development teams.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and maintain communication across technical and mission teams.
* Provide technical guidance and oversight to ensure communications solutions address evolving mission requirements.
* Support the design, configuration, deployment, and sustainment of robust and scalable IT solutions.
* Coordinate with development teams to track and validate technical requirements.
* Apply IT and cybersecurity best practices throughout solution development and implementation.
* Support networking, network security, virtualization, and associated infrastructure technologies.
* Support the implementation and sustainment of Virtual Desktop technologies.
* Train system users on newly implemented technical solutions and capabilities.
* Present technical operations, project status, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

Qualifications:

**Required:**

* An Active TS/SCI with a FSP (preferrably from this client) is required to be considered.
* Bachelor’s degree in a field related to the technical function and at least 11 years of relevant experience developing robust, scalable IT solutions, with an emphasis on virtualization platforms and associated infrastructure; OR
  + Associate’s degree and at least 13 years of related experience; OR
  + No degree and at least 15 years of related experience.
* Demonstrated experience with requirements gathering, stakeholder management, solution configuration and deployment, and user training.
* Experience managing technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, including requirements, implementation, and O&M.
* Experience implementing IT and cybersecurity best practices and working with networking and network security technologies.
* Experience with Virtual Desktop technologies.
* Experience working with development teams to track and validate technical requirements.
* Ability to present and discuss technical operations effectively with senior management.

**Desired:**

* Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Hands-on experience with Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and designing, building, deploying, or maintaining networks.
* Recent hands-on experience (within the last 3 years) with WAN, LAN, and client-access technologies such as MACsec, HSRP, VRF, VPC, ACLs, BGP, and EIGRP.
* Understanding of security monitoring and auditing, including experience guiding systems through the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) process.
* Hands-on experience with commercial cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Experience with commercial voice technologies such as VoIP and PBX.

Salary Range: USD $170,000.00 - USD $200,000.00 /Yr.  
  
The Markon pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. Overview:

Eager to join a team where your skills are valued, your growth is nurtured, and your impact is profound? Look no further than Markon, a premier consulting firm deeply dedicated to advancing our nation's most critical missions.

At Markon, we don't just offer jobs – we offer opportunities for personal and professional transformation. Empowering our employees to lead, innovate, and excel, we foster an environment where new ideas are not just welcomed but celebrated. As a perennial Washington Post Top Workplace, we prioritize the well-being and success of our team members, ensuring they can bring their best selves to work.

Headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, Markon has garnered national recognition for our unwavering dedication to excellence in serving the intelligence community, as well as federal civilian and defense agencies. Our growing reach extends across 17 states, 116 countries, and 5 continents, where our team of dynamic professionals collaborates to deliver unparalleled program and project management services.

Markon values people and the tremendous impact each individual can make – which is why we’re consistently recognized as one of the best places to work in federal government consulting. Here, you can help solve the nation’s most important challenges, surrounded by colleagues who help you grow, advance, and succeed. We are deeply dedicated to what matters – bringing out the best in each other to advance our clients’ missions.  
  
Join us and make a meaningful impact.

Markon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

**Benefits Offered**: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, EAP, Training and Tuition Assistance, Paid Time Off, and Holidays

jobs.title: Technical Systems Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

Markon is seeking a Technical Systems Project Manager to support an Intelligence Community client in Chantilly, Virginia. This position will coordinate operational project planning, engineering services, logistics, and deployment activities supporting a new enterprise-level IT platform and its mission partners. The Technical Systems Project Manager will work across Sponsor organizations, vendors, and program elements to translate stakeholder needs into executable technical plans and guide projects through implementation.

**NOTE:** This position requires infrequent CONUS travel on an "as needed" basis, as directed by the client.

Responsibilities:

* Coordinate the planning, engineering, logistics, implementation, and deployment of a new enterprise-level IT platform and associated network services.
* Develop, coordinate, and execute technical implementation plans across Sponsor organizations, mission partners, vendors, and program elements.
* Identify, document, and track dependencies, requirements, decisions, and action items across multiple stakeholders.
* Define and document technical requirements to ensure solutions appropriately address stakeholder and operational needs.
* Develop and maintain project plans and schedules across multiple stages of the project lifecycle.
* Apply established project management processes to monitor cost, schedule, performance, and project risk, identifying variances and implementing corrective actions when necessary.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee appropriate technical and project documentation.
* Participate in resource planning and develop cost-estimating strategies for future projects.
* Evaluate project issues and adapt plans based on changes to cost, schedule, quality, requirements, or performance.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Engage with internal and external Amazon customers and support teams to gain insights and capture critical mechanical, electrical and utility needs for the business today and in the future
* Utilize those insights to identify specific program requirements, create a program vision, and own the product development roadmap for critical segments of the data center physical infrastructure
* Coordinate between multiple teams to develop compelling business cases to substantiate business value, define product prioritization, and outline budget and resources required to implement product roadmaps
* Drive continuous advancements and improvements within our data center designs, and communicate technical solutions to Senior Management
* Own and drive the complete product lifecycle from idea conception through implementation and wide scale deployment to eventual deprecation

* Work independently in a high-performing environment with all levels of leadership and exercise sound judgment where clear guidelines may not exist

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
