### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting projects for the US Navy- Serco has a terrific opportunity for you!

As the HR Analytics Specialist, you will be on a dynamic team providing technical and programmatic support to the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine Program Offices! Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors and contribute and influence the Navy's future, premier nuclear submarines.

**Must possess an active U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance**

Team Submarine unites the Program Executive Officer, Undersea Warfare Systems (PEO UWS); the Deputy Commander, Undersea Technology (SEA 07); Program Executive Officer, Attack Submarine (PEO SSN); Program Executive Officer, Strategic Subs (PEO SSBN) and the Submarine Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Procurement (SUBMEPP) Activity, once diverse submarine-related commands and activities, into a single "submarine-centric" team. Conceived to increase efficiencies within the submarine acquisition, maintenance, and modernization communities, Team Submarine eliminates traditional "stovepipe" structures and processes that created impediments and inefficiencies in the submarine research, development, acquisition, and maintenance communities. Team Submarine provides improved communication among the various offices that contribute to the overall success of the United States Submarine Force.

We are looking for an energetic, enthusiastic and exceptional person to serve as a highly skilled HR Analytics Specialist with strong expertise in SharePoint development, list management, and workflow automation in the Washington, DC area. In this role, you will bridge the gap between HR data analytics and process optimization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for extracting and analyzing HR data to deliver actionable insights, while simultaneously maintaining, updating, and automating our HR data analytics through our SharePoint infrastructure and workflows. This is a hands-on technical role involves working directly with HR staffing and classification team, requiring a blend of analytical mindset, system administration skills, and process automation expertise.

In this role, you will:

* Provides input to analysis of programs to determine manpower resources necessary to meet program requirements.
* Utilizes modeling and analytic skills to determine costs associated with those resources. Examines identified personnel requirements and capabilities to optimize workforce and missions.
* Familiar with a variety of field concepts, practices, and procedures.
* Rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
* Performs a variety of complicated tasks, such as:
* + Update, restructure, and clean up existing SharePoint lists, document libraries, and metadata columns to support HR processes.
  + Design and build new SharePoint lists, custom views, and user forms to capture HR data efficiently.
  + Manage and audit user permissions, group access, and security configurations within SharePoint Online to ensure strict confidentiality of sensitive HR data.
  + Improve the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) of our internal HR SharePoint pages.
  + Design, build, and troubleshoot automated workflows and SharePoint lists (using Microsoft Power Automate / Microsoft Flow) which assist our HR staffing teams track workload.
  + Set up automated email alerts, approval flows, and status updates linked to SharePoint lists.
  + Integrate SharePoint Online with other Microsoft 365 applications (such as Teams, Power BI, Outlook, and Power Apps) to create seamless, automated end-to-end solutions.
  + Extract, clean, and analyze complex HR datasets from various systems (e.g., payroll, performance, recruiting, demographics).
  + Develop and maintain automated HR dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) using tools like Power BI or Advanced Excel.
  + Deliver insights and trends related to employee retention, turnover, headcount, and other critical HR metrics to support decision-making.
  + Identify data quality issues within SharePoint and connected systems, implementing corrective actions to maintain data integrity.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, technical field, or managerial discipline, or commensurate additional, related experience.

* **Must possess an active DoW Secret security clearance.**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in HR Analytics, HR Systems Administration (HRIS), Business Intelligence, or a closely related technical HR role.
* Advanced level understanding of DoD and US Navy mission, purpose, function and organization.
* Significant experience related to US Navy programs or operations.
* SharePoint development or Microsoft Power Apps experience
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, index-matching, and data formatting).
* Professional experience building interactive reports and dashboards in Power BI.
* M365 Ecosystem: Strong understanding of the broader Microsoft Office 365 environment (Teams, Power Apps, Forms, Outlook).
* To be able to travel 10%.

Desired Education and Experience:

* Knowledge of Navy, NAVSEA or Team Submarine Human Capital policies and processes.

Own your opportunity to support our nation's defense. Make an impact by connecting and securing critical operations across the globe, keeping our country safe and secure.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Contribute to the strategic direction of the business and support impactful mission outcomes as a **National Security Analyst Sr Principal** at GDIT. Here, you’ll enable the success of the most critical government missions and the growth of a meaningful career in Intelligence.

  
  

**MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT**
  
As a National Security Analyst Sr Principal, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of the DTRA client/program. See some of the duties and responsibilities listed below:

  
  

Provide instruction on the history of strategic nuclear arms control treaties and agreements and participate in group discussions and other periods of instruction to provide experience-based perspectives on U.S. nuclear arms control policy development and implementation considerations.

  
  

The instructor should have relevant experience with negotiating and/or implementing bilateral arms control agreements and treaties, either as a member of on-site teams; as a member of a negotiating body; or in an advisory capacity.

  
  

Experience should also include work that has or does contribute to the formation of arms control policy through professional engagements with the broader arms control community of the U.S. Government (USG), the private sector, and academia.

  
  

The instructor shall develop, prepare, and present the following blocks of instruction for each Fundamentals of Strategic Arms Control Implementation Course: An overview of the history of strategic arms control from 1968 to the present: Selected topics or issues (to be specified by the Government) pertaining to INF, START, and New START (i.e., technical issues, implementation topics, etc.).

  
  

Will serve as an expert perspective regarding the arms control concepts, national security priorities, and relevant arms control treaties—to include INF—that formed the basis of the original START compared to those supporting the New START.

  
  

The perspective should also be representative of emerging nuclear arms control regime policies and risk reduction measures from USG stakeholders, private industry, and academia.

  
  

The instructor will provide briefing materials and participate in panel discussions regarding relevant arms control treaties, agreements, and risk reduction measures, to include challenges to future nuclear agreement negotiations and implementation.

  
  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED**
  
Bring your initiative and drive for innovation to GDIT. The National Security Analyst Sr Principal must have:

* Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science or work experience in lieu of degree.

* Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities

* Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off

jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**What it's all about -**

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.

The Strategy & Commercial Operations team plays a critical role in shaping and executing the VCA Europe strategy. The team supports business planning, go-to-market execution, commercial performance management, practice area growth, pipeline development, leadership reporting and strategic initiatives that enable VCA to scale, diversify revenue and deliver stronger client outcomes across Europe. The Analyst, VCA Strategy & Commercial Operations, will play an important role in supporting the growth of VCA Europe across a number of areas including go-to-market, thought leadership, strategic initiatives and business planning.

**Specific Responsibilities include:**

* Support execution of VCA Europe’s strategy by conducting analysis, tracking strategic initiatives, and helping translate priorities into actionable plans
* Support go-to-market initiatives by developing analyses, tracking progress against objectives, and helping coordinate execution across stakeholders.
* Partner with Corporate Communications, VCA Europe Leadership, BPO, Business Development teams, Finance, and other stakeholders to gather inputs and support strategy and go-to-market initiatives including thought leadership.
* Develop executive-ready presentations, reports, dashboards, and briefing materials to support leadership decision-making.
* Support strategic projects and transformation initiatives, including growth programs, AI-related initiatives, operating model improvements, and business performance enhancement efforts.
* Contribute to governance and business review processes by coordinating inputs, preparing materials, tracking actions, and monitoring progress against key priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and ways of working, helping drive greater efficiency and operational effectiveness across the organization.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**What we'd like from you**

* Several years of relevant experience in strategy, consulting, business operations, commercial operations, analytics, finance, or a structured graduate program.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and develop actionable business insights.
* Demonstrated interest in strategy execution, go-to-market initiatives, business performance management, and commercial growth.
* Strong AI literacy, with the ability to effectively leverage AI and digital tools to improve operational efficiency, accelerate insight generation, enhance deliverable quality, and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale processes
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel including experience developing analyses, business cases, and executive presentations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborative team player with experience working across functions and levels, and building effective stakeholder relationships.
* Demonstrated curiosity, ownership, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to learning and continuous improvement.
* An affinity for payments, technology, FinTech and digital is a plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Technical Program Manager, Interconnect Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global AWS network. It is dedicated to facilitating the internet traffic that allows users to access their information and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is also responsible for building and designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between Data Centers and customers.  
  
The Interconnect team is responsible for delivering the interconnect capacity connecting the Amazon network to the internet.  
The Interconnect TIPM will support the Interconnect Business Developers (BDs) to ensure that this delivery of capacity is friction-less to both internal and external networks. One form of this capacity is the use of embedded caches which are deployed with ISPs' networks.
  
  
The role of the TIPM includes supporting the coordination and project management with those external ISPs for the deployment of caches. The TIPM is expected to anticipate issues or problems with the wide-scale global deployment of embedded caches with ISPs, including supply-chain, logistics, installation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, reporting, tools and operations. The TIPM is expected to find opportunities for process improvements and introduction of new tools or automation.  
If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we’d love for you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks.  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst – Labour & Productivity
jobs.description:
**The Role..**

We are starting a labour optimisation programme with our Operations team, alongside FP&A and Data Science. The aim is to improve our wage percentage to sales while improving service standards at the same time. We are not interested in an approach that delivers one at the expense of the other.

We are currently selecting an advanced scheduling platform to support this. The analytical foundation underneath it,how we measure productivity, what our labour standards are, how good our demand forecasts need to be - is what this role owns.

You will sit in the Data team and work in close partnership with FP&A. Analysis alone will not move the number; changes stick when a Finance Business Partner and a General Manager can see the opportunity in their own House, agree the size of it and hold it in their forecast. Your job is to give them that, in a form they can act on.

**Key Responsibilities..**

* Labour productivity analysis, identifying site-by-site opportunities for efficiency gains and sizing each one
* Work with Operations and Finance to trial changes to scheduling and measure their impact
* Build improved labour reporting, so Business Partners and GMs can see productivity, schedule changes and shift adherence on a daily and weekly cadence
* Support Finance translate demand forecasts into labour requirements, helping to build the models that turn covers, check-ins, treatments and occupancy into hours by role
* Partner with our Data Science and Operations teams to understand forecast accuracy and recommend improvements
* Connect labour deployment to member experience, so that productivity gains are demonstrably not coming out of the House

What we are looking for..

* Proven experience in labour optimisation. You have personally delivered measurable improvement in wage percentage or sales per labour hour in a multi-site operation, and can talk us through the levers you pulled, how you sized them and how you proved the result
* A track record of partnering finance and operational stakeholders to land change, not just report on it
* Several years in an analytics role, with genuine multi-site operational exposure — hospitality, retail, leisure or QSR
* Advanced SQL, and comfort in a modelled data warehouse (experience with dbt an advantage)
* BI development experience (Omni, Looker, Tableau or Power BI), building tools operators actually use
* Experience with rota, time and attendance and payroll data, and a realistic view of its challenges
* Able to evaluate a demand forecast critically — accuracy, bias, seasonality — without needing to build one

Desirable..

* Experience with a workforce management or scheduling platform — Unifocus, HotSchedules, Dayforce, Fourth, S4 Labour, UKG, Quinyx or similar
* Strong financial modelling and fluency in P&L mechanics — wage percentage, flow-through, contribution
* An understanding of how labour regulation constrains labour models internationally, particularly the US — predictive scheduling and fair workweek rules, overtime and break requirements
* Labour standards or time-and-motion experience
* Python for data analysis and modelling, and/or use of AI tooling such as Claude Code to accelerate it
* Experience linking labour deployment to customer experience outcomes

jobs.title: Financial Crime Implementation Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a leading financial services organisation as it begins a multi-year financial crime transformation programme, centred on implementing Fenergo as its client lifecycle management platform.

This is a hands-on analysis role in the programme's implementation workstream. You will work across the organisation's KYC, onboarding and periodic review processes. That means establishing how they operate today, defining how they need to operate in future, and turning that into requirements the programme can deliver.

The work is requirements-led. You will engage Financial Crime, Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders, map current and target state processes, and make sure what is configured in Fenergo reflects both internal policy and regulatory obligations. Because the programme is regulatory-driven, the analysis needs to be traceable, well evidenced and able to withstand scrutiny from compliance, audit and risk.

The role suits a business analyst from a financial crime change background, ideally with exposure to a CLM implementation. You should combine structured analysis with the confidence to work directly with subject matter experts and senior stakeholders. This is an initial 6-month engagement, with a strong likelihood of extension to two years as the programme progresses. It is based in London, with three days per week on site, and is expected to start as soon as possible.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Elicit, document and validate business requirements across KYC, CDD, EDD and client onboarding processes.
* Map current and target state processes, identifying gaps against internal policy and regulatory obligations.
* Support the configuration of Fenergo, including policy rules, data requirements, risk models and workflow design.
* Carry out data analysis and data mapping to support the migration of client records onto the new platform.
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria, making sure requirements are clear, testable and traceable.
* Support test planning and execution, including UAT, and track defects through to resolution.
* Work with Financial Crime, Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders to secure alignment and sign-off on requirements.
* Contribute to business readiness, including procedure updates, training materials and change impact assessments.

  
**Requirements**  

* A background in business analysis within financial crime, KYC or client onboarding change in financial services.
* A sound understanding of AML, KYC, CDD and EDD requirements, including the UK Money Laundering Regulations and JMLSG guidance.
* Fenergo implementation experience is strongly preferred, though exposure to other CLM platforms will also be considered.
* Strong process mapping, requirements gathering and documentation skills.
* Experience writing user stories and supporting UAT in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* Confidence working with data, including data mapping and migration analysis.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.
* A relevant BA certification (e.g. BCS) or financial crime qualification (e.g. ICA) is an advantage.

  
**Benefits**

Length: Initial 6-month contract, with likely extension to two years  
Salary: £42,000–£55,000, dependent on experience

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
LNT/PM/1881906

* PTD-Power Transmission & Distribution - IC
* Jabeli Ali, Dubai

* Posted On 06 Oct 2026
* End Date 04 Apr 2027
* Required Experience16 - 24 years

  

**Skills**
----------

#### **Knowledge & Posting Location**

PMP Program Management Project Management

#### **Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor of Engineering (BE)

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Project Manager is responsible for the overall planning, execution, monitoring, control, and successful delivery of electrical substation projects, including 132kV, 220kV, 400kV, and distribution substations, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, project specifications, quality standards, safety regulations, and client expectations. The role involves leading multidisciplinary teams comprising civil, electrical, mechanical, commissioning, QA/QC, HSE, planning, procurement, and subcontractor personnel to achieve project objectives within approved schedules and budgets. The Project Manager oversees the complete project lifecycle from initiation, engineering coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and final handover, while ensuring effective stakeholder management with clients, consultants, utility authorities, vendors, and subcontractors. Key responsibilities include project planning, resource allocation, schedule monitoring, cost control, risk management, contract administration, progress reporting, and implementation of recovery plans to mitigate delays and project risks. The Project Manager ensures seamless coordination among various disciplines, resolves technical and commercial issues, monitors project performance against key milestones, and drives compliance with quality assurance, quality control, and HSE requirements. The role also includes managing project budgets, evaluating variations and claims, optimizing resource utilization, reviewing project deliverables, overseeing procurement activities, and ensuring timely availability of materials and equipment. Additionally, the Project Manager leads progress review meetings, monitors subcontractor performance, supports testing and commissioning activities, ensures closure of punch points and NCRs, and oversees the preparation of as-built documentation and project closeout reports. The ideal candidate possesses strong leadership, communication, negotiation, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with extensive experience in managing high-voltage substation and EPC projects. Through effective project governance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic leadership, the Project Manager ensures the successful, safe, and profitable delivery of substation projects while meeting client requirements and organizational objectives.

jobs.description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

This position is created to support the AGORA ERP implementation within Gas Services Distributed in the United Arab Emirates, with a strategic plan to transition the resource into a permanent Commercial Project Manager (CPM) vacancy to retain critical system and business knowledge. Operating within the SE FIN GS ME CPM-D organization, the role initially will focus on ERP system deployment then will transition to commercial execution in all service lines; long-term service contracts, M&U, Repairs, complex Spare Parts deliveries, Field Services. To address this dual-phase objective, the role focuses on ERP implementation and system optimization, comprehensive financial project management, and risk, contract, and stakeholder management.

These core areas ensure a seamless transition from system setup to high-performing project execution. Given the focus on ERP implementation and project execution, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in finance or business administration, proven experience as a Commercial Project Manager for complex service projects, and deep proficiency in SAP/ERP systems. Professional certification CPM-C category is highly desirable to support the Gas Services business.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Manage and optimize project financial KPIs including revenue, cost, gross profit, cash flow, assets, and financing instruments. Ensure compliance with Financial Reporting Guidelines (FRG), non-conformance costs (NCC), transfer pricing, tax, and export control regulations.
* Actively performs asset management, initiates invoicing according to project progress and contractual terms. Ensure payment is received on time and allocated properly. Perform project forecasting, local and WTW reporting, involve offshore CPM organization.
* Manage project guarantees, bonds and project insurance as well as foreign currency risks in alignment with hedging guidelines.
* Act as a key user and data steward to support the smooth and successful implementation of ERP/SAP (S4EUnify / AGORA) within the Commercial Project Management domain. Retain and document system knowledge gained during ERP implementation to train and support the wider CPM organization.
* Ensure accurate recording and migration of commercial project data into the new ERP system.
* Collaborate with the Project Manager to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and opportunities. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, subcontractors, and offshore teams, to ensure commercial alignment.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related qualification. Certified CPM for 'C' Category projects
* Proven experience as a Commercial Project Manager handling long-term or complex 'C' category projects, preferably in the service/LTSA sector
* Experience with ERP/SAP implementations in a project business environment
* Strong background in financial reporting guidelines (FRG) and IFRS, project forecasting, budgeting and reporting, asset and cash flow management, as well as transfer pricing and tax compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel and PowerPoint), experience in data stewardship and system implementation, as well as expertise in SAP/ERP implementation.
* Expertise in contract and claim management, project risk and opportunity management, as well as foreign currency hedging and risk mitigation.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, effective stakeholder management and communication abilities, as well as problem-solving skills and adaptability.

**About the Team**

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**

* Opportunity to work on challenging projects in an exciting environment
* Opportunity for remote/flexible work
* Professional support and strong collaboration with colleagues around the world
* Professional development opportunities within the company

As a leader in clean energy program implementation and consulting, EIP is proud to help clients achieve meaningful environmental and economic outcomes through innovative, high-impact projects.

**Position Description**

EIP is seeking a highly organized and motivated Program Manager to support implementation of a Large Commercial Energy Efficiency Program for a major California natural gas utility. In this role, you will manage day-to-day program operations and support successful delivery of services to large commercial customers.

The Program Manager will play a key role in coordinating program activities across internal staff, customers, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure services are delivered effectively, program requirements are met, and administrative processes are completed accurately and on time. This includes managing program planning, supervising program staff, tracking performance, coordinating service delivery, preparing reports, overseeing invoicing support, supporting internal financial management, and helping maintain strong communication across the program team.

This role also serves as the primary day-to-day point of contact for the utility client, with responsibility for maintaining a strong client relationship, coordinating with utility staff regarding approvals and program support needs, and ensuring alignment on priorities, schedules, deliverables, and performance expectations. In addition, the Program Manager may conduct outreach to high-potential customers to support program participation and strategic project development.

The Program Manager may also support EIP’s broader business development efforts in California by helping build relationships in the energy efficiency community, identifying and qualifying potential opportunities, contributing to proposal and pricing development, supporting partnership development, and representing EIP in relevant industry forums and market conversations.

The Program Manager works closely with program leadership, outreach staff, account managers, engineers, finance, administrative staff, and business development leadership to support a high-quality customer experience, strong program performance, and continued market growth.

* **Program Operations Management:** Manage day-to-day implementation of program services to ensure activities are delivered efficiently, on schedule, and in alignment with program requirements.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for the utility client, maintaining strong communication, responsiveness, and coordination on program needs, approvals, and performance.
* **Service Delivery Coordination:** Coordinate internal teams and program activities to support effective delivery of services to large commercial customers.
* **Staff Supervision:** Supervise program staff, support accountability and performance, and help ensure work is completed at a high level of quality.
* **Financial and Administrative Management:** Support internal financial management of the project, including P&L oversight, invoicing, reporting, and coordination with finance and leadership.
* **Performance Tracking:** Monitor program activity, pipeline movement, project status, customer participation, and other key metrics to support program goals and timely issue resolution.
* **Strategic Customer Engagement:** Conduct or support outreach to high-potential customers where needed to advance participation and project opportunities.
* **Business Development Support:** Help strengthen EIP’s market presence in California by building relationships, identifying and qualifying opportunities, supporting proposal development, and contributing to strategic partnerships.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify process improvements and operational efficiencies that strengthen program performance and customer experience.

* **Manage Client Relationship**: Serve as the primary point of contact for the utility client on day-to-day matters, including status updates, issue resolution, planning discussions, approvals, and coordination of support needs.

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

jobs.title: Program Cybersecurity Manager
jobs.description:
Clearance Level

None

Category

Cyber and IT Risk Management

Location

Los Angeles, California

*(**Onsite Workplace**)*

Key Skills For Success

Information Technology (IT) Services

Leadership

Security Compliance

##### **REQ#:****RQ228920**

##### **Public Trust:****NACI (T1)**

##### **Requisition Type:****Pipeline**

##### **Your Impact**

Own your opportunity to work alongside federal civilian agencies. Make an impact by delivering solutions that improve citizen services millions depends on.

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

GDIT is seeking a highly experienced Program Cybersecurity Manager to support our NASA Business Area in driving the successful strategy, oversight, and execution of cybersecurity initiatives across our expanding NASA portfolio.

  
  

GDIT is your place to make mission‑driven contributions to critical federal programs and grow a rewarding career. The Program Cybersecurity Manager will play a central role in developing and managing an integrated cybersecurity strategy that protects mission systems and data through 24x7 security operations, advanced AI‑enabled cyber capabilities, enterprise risk management, compliance with NASA and Federal requirements, and coordinated engineering and IT Service Management (ITSM) resources.

  
  

As the Program Cybersecurity Manager supporting this opportunity, you will provide cybersecurity leadership to internal teams and the NASA JPL customers. You will establish, lead and continuously improve the cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk management, architecture, engineering and operations for the program. You will also support GDIT’s account management for NASA JPL with a focus on cyber program growth, customer relationship management, and secure service delivery. This position will ensure that solutions and execution align with modern enterprise cybersecurity best practices, federal mandates, and NASA’s evolving security landscape.

  
  

The successful candidate will be an experienced cybersecurity executive with prior NASA JPL support experience and a proven track record of leading complex cyber programs. The candidate must demonstrate excellence in personnel leadership, customer engagement, enterprise cyber strategy, and driving measurable improvements in security posture. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential for this role, which requires the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment with multiple concurrent workstreams.

  
  

In this Program Cybersecurity Manager role, you will be responsible for executing GDIT’s cybersecurity strategy while ensuring compliance with Federal, NIST, and NASA requirements. This position requires a motivated, seasoned leader who can navigate complex challenges, drive secure solutions with precision, and foster trust-based relationships with internal and customer stakeholders.

  
  

**Responsibilities Include:**

  
  

**Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration**

* Build and nurture trust with customers by delivering consistent, high-quality cybersecurity results and maintaining transparent communication.

* Set realistic expectations with stakeholders by clearly communicating risk, compliance posture, and mitigation strategies.

* Serve as the primary cybersecurity advisor and point of contact for internal teams and NASA customers, and provides clear, risk-based recommendations on cybersecurity priorities, investments, threats, and program impacts.

  
  

**Strategic Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Execute GDIT’s cybersecurity imperatives with direct alignment to NASA JPL standards, policies, and the NASA Community.

* Demonstrate a consultative mindset by identifying emerging threats, recommending strategic improvements, and implementing actionable, measurable security enhancements.

* Strengthen customer experience by ensuring secure service delivery that aligns with NASA mission needs and enterprise security expectations.

  
  

**Cyber Program Management**

* Develop, maintain, and oversee cybersecurity strategy, program plans, and security architecture supporting NASA JPL missions.

* Direct cybersecurity operations teams, engineering teams, and incident response functions to ensure effective execution of NASA and federal security requirements.

* Proactively identify security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats; adjust program plans and defenses as needed to maintain security compliance and resilience.

  
  

**Performance, Compliance, and Quality Oversight**

* Ensure all security deliverables meet required quality standards and comply with NASA, NIST, federal cybersecurity frameworks, and regulatory guidelines.

* Track, analyze, and report on cybersecurity metrics, risks, and program performance using data-driven insights.

* Oversee continuous monitoring, incident response, audit readiness, and enterprise risk management activities.

jobs.description:
**Lead Project Manager**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Fulltime Regular  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Exempt  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
The **Deep Synoptic Array (DSA)** is a next-generation radio telescope being developed for deployment in a radio-quiet valley in Nevada. Comprising 1,650 dishes, the DSA is designed to survey the sky at unprecedented speed and sensitivity. During its five-year initial survey, the DSA is expected to detect more than one billion astronomical sources, produce images and transient alerts in real time, and rapidly deliver science-ready data products to the astronomical community. The DSA brings together scientists, engineers, technical experts, and project professionals across a large, multidisciplinary collaboration. As the project advances toward construction and operations, the DSA offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and delivery of a major new facility at the forefront of radio astronomy.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
The Lead Project Manager, in partnership with the Principal Investigator (PI) team and Deputy Project Manager, provides strategic leadership and integrated project management for the design, development, construction, and future operation of the DSA, one of the world's most advanced radio astronomy initiatives. The position is responsible for coordinating project planning, governance, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, environmental compliance, infrastructure development, and organizational planning across a large, multidisciplinary, multi-institutional collaboration.  
  
Working closely with the Principal Investigators, Deputy Project Manager, Project Engineer, institutional leadership, consultants, contractors, funding agencies, and government organizations, the Lead Project Manager ensures alignment across scientific, engineering, technical, operational, and administrative workstreams while supporting the successful execution of the project from conceptual design through construction and operations.  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  
  
The Lead Project Manager provides strategic leadership for execution of the DSA project scope, schedule, budget, and integrated project management functions, working in partnership with the Deputy Project Manager and broader project leadership.  

* Serve as the primary project management lead, providing strategic direction across multiple technical, programmatic, and organizational workstreams.
* Lead integrated project planning and execution supporting conceptual design, construction, and long-term operations, including project schedules, budgets, milestones, deliverables, and resource planning.
* Direct project management methodologies, governance processes, document control systems, reporting mechanisms, and organizational practices that support effective project execution.

* Lead organizational planning, stakeholder communications, and multidisciplinary coordination across the expanding DSA collaboration, ensuring alignment of priorities, responsibilities, and project objectives.
* Manage the Environmental Impact Study (EIS) and associated regulatory activities in coordination with consultants, the Bureau of Land Management, tribal representatives, regulatory agencies, and local communities.
* Oversee planning, specification, procurement, and implementation of project infrastructure, including buildings, power systems, communications, utilities, and access roads.
* Coordinate consultants, contractors, and partner institutions to ensure alignment with project objectives, schedules, budgets, technical requirements, and quality standards.
* Support strategic planning and development of project execution plans, technical and programmatic documentation, funding proposals, presentations, and other materials supporting future project funding and long-term project needs.
* Organize and facilitate executive meetings, technical reviews, workshops, and cross-functional coordination meetings, ensuring effective communication and follow-through.
* Coordinate closely with the broader DSA management team to establish priorities, resolve project issues, and support strategic decision-making as the project advances toward construction and operations.
* Travel as required to Caltech, OVRO, partner institutions, and project sites.

**Why qlub**

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

**The role**

qlub is scaling rapidly across the US, and we're looking for a **Field Implementation Manager** to own the successful launch of new restaurant partners across the market.

This is a **field-based role**. You'll spend most of your time **on-site with restaurant partners**, taking venues from signed agreements to fully live and operational. You'll coordinate implementation activities, configure and deploy qlub's solutions, train restaurant teams, troubleshoot issues, and ensure every launch meets our operational and customer experience standards.

You'll work closely with Sales, Operations, Product, and Technical teams to remove implementation blockers and deliver a seamless launch experience. This role requires someone who is highly hands-on, commercially aware, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment.

If you enjoy being in the field, solving problems in real time, and taking ownership from **"signed" to "live,"** this role is for you.

**What you’ll own**

* Own end-to-end venue implementations, from handover after contract signature through launch and stabilization
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Product, and Technical teams to ensure every implementation is delivered on time and to a high standard
* Conduct on-site venue visits to assess operational requirements, configure solutions, deploy hardware/software, and prepare restaurants for launch
* Lead hands-on training and enablement for restaurant owners, managers, and front-of-house teams to ensure they are confident using qlub
* Troubleshoot implementation and operational issues on-site, working with internal teams to drive issues through to resolution

* Build strong relationships with restaurant partners and act as the primary implementation point of contact throughout the launch process

**Who you are**

* You've done this before in a fast-moving, high-growth environment
* You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information
* You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator
* You're energized by hard problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience

**What you’ll need**

* 3+ years of experience in Implementation, Customer Success, Field Operations, Account Management, Onboarding, or a similar customer-facing operational role
* Proven experience managing end-to-end implementations, launches, or deployments across multiple customers or locations
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and coordinating projects against tight deadlines
* Exceptional in-person and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly with customers and internal teams
* Strong problem-solving and project management skills with excellent attention to detail
* Comfortable working independently and managing your own schedule across a large geographic territory
* Valid US driver's license and access to reliable transportation
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned market and spend the majority of your time on-site with restaurant partners

**Nice to have**

* Experience working with multi-location restaurant groups or enterprise customers
* Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

**What we offer**

* Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally
* The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience
* A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality
* Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts
* A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.

  

We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

  

We're hiring a motivated internally facing **Business Analyst** to learn how CompassX actually runs — across Consulting Operations, Sales, Talent, and more — by getting hands-on with the work itself, then using that ground-level view to identify what's inefficient, recommend a better way, and build it.

This isn't a role where you sit outside the work and hand off recommendations to someone else. You'll learn our processes from the inside, spot where they break down, bring forward a clear fix, and then help make it real. As a small firm, you'll get exposure across nearly every function — no task is too small or too big. It's a high-visibility role with direct exposure to firm leadership from day one.

* Get hands-on across teams - Consulting Operations, Sales, Talent, and beyond - to genuinely understand how work moves before trying to change it.

$45,000 - $60,000 a year

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

**To learn more about us:** **About Swan** **;** **Our story****.**

Swan is looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data team, led by Romain, our VP Data. The team has 9 people across data engineering, analytics engineering and data analysis.

This is a hybrid role. Half of it is being a business partner: you'll work hand in hand with your stakeholders, help them ask the right questions, and turn data into recommendations that shape their decisions.

* **Drive AI adoption within the team:** Identify where AI can make analysts more effective, from writing SQL to documenting dashboards and answering recurring requests. Test new tools and practices, and help the team adopt the ones that deliver real value.
* **Help the rest of Swan get value from data**: Run internal projects for stakeholders, such as Metabase training and a data onboarding program for new Swanees, so that teams become more autonomous and confident with data.

* You enjoy **sharing knowledge**: training, documentation, onboarding or helping others become autonomous with data.
* You handle **sensitive or confidential data** with care and discretion.

jobs.title: Senior Business Data Analyst
jobs.description:
***Before we get started:***  
Here at Ingenio, we'd love to talk with you regardless of your qualifications or years of experience. If you believe you'd be a great fit for this role, we invite you to apply even if you do not meet all points on the job description.

***Who we are:***  
Ingenio is on a mission to make spiritual wellness a core part of modern self-care. We are a global media and technology company developing products that provide guidance on love, relationships, careers, and all aspects of life. We are passionate about connecting people with the world's best advisors and content to restore spiritual wellness to its rightful place, easing the stress of modern life with trusted ancient practices.

Our global portfolio spans over 20 marketplace and media brands in the spiritual and emotional wellness space. Our flagship brands include Keen, Horoscope.com, Astrology.com, Purple Garden, Kasamba, and Kang.

***How you'll be impactful:***  
We are seeking a Senior Business Data Analyst to elevate our understanding of financial, product, and marketing performance across our EU brand portfolio. The ideal candidate will have expertise in B2C financial monitoring, marketplace dynamics, product analytics, and marketing analytics, along with experience analyzing interactions between buyers and sellers. This role involves communicating insights to executive leadership and partnering with Marketplace Success, Product, and Marketing teams by developing and managing Tableau reports that track key metrics, playing a critical part in shaping strategic direction and optimizing brand performance. Our European data currently sits across multiple local and international systems, so a key part of this role is connecting and reconciling these sources into a consistent, trusted view of performance.  
  
*Please note: This role will require being in our Paris office at least 3 days per week.*

  

***What*** ***you'll be doing:***

* Lead financial analysis of brand results: Revenue, Engagement, Retention; and create analysis to better understand both supply and demand behavior.
* Connect and reconcile data across local and international systems to build a consistent, trusted view of European performance.
* Partner with executive leadership to surface insights and drive accountability and growth.
* Partner with Marketplace Success to increase retention and monetization of loyal customers; utilization and revenue of sellers.
* Analyze product usage and user behavior to inform feature development, funnel optimization, and onboarding improvements, partnering closely with Product teams.
* Evaluate marketing campaign performance across channels, including acquisition efficiency, attribution, and ROAS, partnering closely with Marketing teams.
* Proactively explore available data to generate actionable insights and advocate strategies that increase business value.
* Maintain reports, decks and dashboards that track KPIs and provide insights into marketplace, product, and marketing effectiveness and ROI.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify key issues and opportunities, support business strategy based on data-driven insights.

***What*** ***you'll need to be successful:***

* 5+ years of experience analyzing marketplace operations, revenue analytics, product analytics, marketing analytics, consulting, finance, or business strategy.
* Bachelor's degree in mathematics, statistics, economics or related quantitative fields.
* Exceptional skills in Google Sheets, Excel, Slides, Powerpoint, data extraction and analysis.
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Skilled in Tableau/Data visualization software. Familiarity with Python and/or R is a plus.
* Experience working with fragmented or legacy data environments (multiple local/international systems) is a strong plus.
* Experience in analysis of revenue, customer behavior and marketplace dynamics. Familiarity with Product Analytics tools (Mixpanel) and marketing analytics/attribution platforms is a plus.
* Proven ability to frame and solve problems by extracting insight from raw data.
* Team player with a result-oriented approach, capable of navigating ambiguity and initiating/driving projects to completion.
* Expert in creation of presentations and reports for executive leadership to communicate findings, recommendations, and performance metrics. Exceptional communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Fluent French and English required; German is a plus given the European scope of this role.

***Perks & Benefits:***

* Collaborative, high-performing, and entrepreneurial team
* Employee referral bonus program
* Company swag
* Birthday PTO
* Summer Fridays
* Meal vouchers
* Learning & development support, including dedicated budget
* Regular in-person and virtual team events

***Why Ingenio?***  
Our growing team of over 300 employees is powered by our diverse perspectives and company core values:

* We are humble. We believe the best result is achieved by leveraging others' perspectives
* We think like owners. We make decisions that optimize for the greater good of the organization
* We challenge limiting beliefs. We are at our best when we identify and shatter status quo expectations

*Ingenio is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.*

jobs.title: Chemical & Natural Resources Cybersecurity Manager/Senior Manager
jobs.description:
**We Are**

Accenture's Cybersecurity practice, a global leader in delivering end-to-end cybersecurity services across strategy, risk management, digital identity, cyber defense, and managed security. With security professionals in 70 countries and specialized facilities like Cyber Fusion Centers and Cyber Labs, we focus on embedding security into digital transformation programs, and delivering targeted cybersecurity solutions to protect digital assets, manage cybersecurity risks, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. We address the evolving challenges of cybersecurity in today's digital landscape. Our cybersecurity practice is supported by a global network of cybersecurity professionals, advanced tools, and partnerships with leading technology providers. We help organizations build resilience, protect their operations, and enable growth in a secure digital environment.

**You Are**

Passionate about leveraging cybersecurity innovation to drive strategic transformation across the Chemicals & Natural Resources (CNR) industries, including chemical manufacturers, oil & gas operators, mining companies, and agricultural enterprises. You develop and deliver cybersecurity services that protect critical infrastructure, enable operational modernization, manage enterprise and operational risk, and support compliance with industry-specific regulatory requirements. This role demands deep expertise across IT and OT environments and the ability to guide CNR clients through complex business, technology, safety, and resilience challenges. You assess current and future cybersecurity capabilities, advise on leading practices, and shape cybersecurity strategies aligned with each client's business priorities, regulatory obligations, and operational realities.

**The Work:**

As a Cybersecurity Manager, you will manage complex information security engagements and workstreams. You will provide cybersecurity subject matter expertise, coordinate project delivery, and serve as a key point of contact for client security, business, and IT stakeholders, Accenture domain experts, and third-party teams. You will lead; manage plans, risks, budgets, and deliverables; and help shape practical solutions that achieve committed client outcomes.

As a team member, you'll be part of a Chemicals & Natural Resources industry team focused on applying cybersecurity expertise across the CNR value chain — from upstream exploration and extraction, to refining, processing, and distribution, through to chemical manufacturing and end-product delivery. You'll work closely with our CNR industry leaders to innovate and shape secure, resilient solutions for operational technology modernization, supply chain security, and industrial process safety.

* **Client Engagement:** Build trusted working relationships with chemical, oil & gas, mining, and agricultural client stakeholders, translating their cybersecurity, safety, regulatory, and operational resilience priorities into actionable workplans and deliverables.
* **Initiative Delivery:** Manage cybersecurity workstreams and project teams delivering solutions across cyber defense, AI-enabled security, risk management, and compliance, aligned with client objectives, scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.

jobs.title: Deal Strategy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are seeking a **Deal Strategy Program Manager** to help us scale how we support our sales organization. This role is a critical partner to sales and collaborates closely with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations, helping move deals forward with speed, sound judgment, and operational rigor. Beyond executing day-to-day deal support, this role independently owns complex deals end-to-end, shapes the processes and systems the broader team relies on, and is a go-to resource for less-experienced teammates.

You'll play a central role in structuring deals, improving process quality, and helping our sales team close business efficiently and responsibly. We're looking for someone who operates with real autonomy, exercises sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and is energized by solving problems in a fast-paced environment. This is a strong next step for someone who has built foundational deal desk or revenue operations experience and is ready to own outcomes independently, influence process and policy, and begin mentoring others.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own Deal Execution**

* Serve as a senior, trusted advisor to Sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on structuring and executing complex, non-standard, and high-value deals
* Independently evaluate and resolve non-standard deal requests, driving cross-functional solutions across Sales, Finance, and Legal with minimal oversight
* Own deals end-to-end through quoting, approval, contracting, and quote-to-cash — troubleshooting issues with Finance and Legal with urgency, accuracy, and attention to policy and business context
* Ensure all transactions adhere to internal revenue recognition policies, escalating and resolving edge cases as needed
* Present deal strategy recommendations and insights to senior stakeholders in a clear, concise, data-driven manner

**Elevate Operational Quality**

* Ensure deal data is complete and accurate in CRM, with a focus on data hygiene and process compliance
* Reinforce and help enforce pricing and discounting governance, exercising judgment in gray areas rather than simply applying rules
* Define requirements for system enhancements (e.g., CRM, CPQ) in partnership with systems and RevOps teams

**Drive Process Improvement & Scale**

* Proactively identify friction in current processes and lead improvements — including automation and AI (e.g., AI-assisted contract review, quote generation, deal analytics) — to increase speed, consistency, and scale, and reduce manual effort
* Own the optimization of policies, playbooks, and standard operating procedures for deal support, and lead their rollout and adoption across the global team
* Act as a go-to resource for other analysts on sales operations planning, process, and execution

**Support & Mentor**

* Informally mentor newer Revenue Operations Support Analysts on deal structuring, systems, and policy
* Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing — documentation, training sessions, and onboarding materials — recommending process changes and leading training so improvements scale beyond a single deal

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------

* Business Degree
* 5-7+ years of experience (Deal Desk, Finance, Pricing or Sales Operations experience required), software industry experience preferred.
* Demonstrated experience independently owning complex deals or projects, not just executing defined tasks
* Experience supporting SaaS, cloud, or technology sales organizations
* Strong fluency in systems like Salesforce, CPQ tools, and reporting platforms, with an eye toward data integrity for downstream reporting and forecasting
* Sound judgment for navigating ambiguous or non-standard deal situations, knowing when to escalate versus resolve independently
* A track record of recommending and helping implement process or policy improvements
* Contract management and negotiation experience strongly preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with first-principles thinking
* Self-starter mentality with a proactive eagerness to learn, mentor others, and level up the revenue operations team
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing stakeholder needs in a fast-paced environment
* Experience using or implementing AI or automation tools (e.g., generative AI, workflow automation, CPQ automation) to improve deal desk efficiency and accuracy a plus

**Compensation Range:**
-----------------------

* $90,000 - $120,000

* This is a remote role

JR: 2026-8286

*#LI-Remote*

**Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean**
--------------------------------------------

* **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.
* **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. ### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, engineering, security management, or business field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience managing physical security technology projects (such as enterprise access control, CCTV, intrusion detection systems, and physical barriers) from design through to deployment and commissioning.
* 3 years of experience in technical program management, leading cross-functional teams in a global or regional environment, specifically within logistics, warehousing, or industrial settings.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end security procurement, agreement bid packages, and working directly with major external security systems integrators and equipment manufacturers.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM), Warehouse and Logistics Security Systems, you will be responsible for the design, standardization, and implementation of physical security systems across Google global warehouse and logistics footprint. You must have professional program management experience along with expert-level technical know-how of large-scale logistics, distribution center, or critical infrastructure physical security deployments.

You will be responsible for designing and reviewing security systems, standardizing layouts, creating design concepts, and managing testing and commissioning. A key component of this role is managing the distinct security strategies across various Google warehouse archetypes.

You will collaborate with internal supply chain partners, deployment teams, hardware logistics teams, security operations and external systems integrators to ensure that the warehouse security systems program is aligned with current global security policies, and that all physical deployments meet compliance and industry standards, including TAPA FSR Level A Certification.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Author detailed security design templates and maintain physical security technical specifications (including Division 28) to ensure all warehouse tiers comply with Google's asset protection standards.
* Oversee physical security construction from inception to completion, coordinating both temporary safeguarding measures and permanent system deployments in partnership with site teams.
* Support vendor bidding (producing technical specifications, running RFPs, and awarding agreements), directing final site walks, systems testing, and as-built repository hand-offs.
* Facilitate the seamless integration of warehouse security systems into the Security Operations Center (SOC) and Center of Excellence (COE) to enable real-time tracking and response.
* Partner with Logistics Security to achieve and maintain TAPA FSR Level A Certification while optimizing design efficiency to support rapid global data center growth.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Product Operations Central (Process and Business Intelligence) is a core component of the Product Operations team, providing a centralized hub of multi-disciplinary expertise that fortifies the strategic and operational framework for Business Units (BUs) across Cisco’s product portfolio. This team acts as a strategic partner, collaborating with cross-functional leaders to define Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) strategies, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation across NPI, sustaining, and end-to-end supply chain processes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
In this role, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our future by proactively collaborating with peers, senior leaders, and functional SMEs. By implementing innovative analytical solutions, you will ensure our operational framework is both scalable and highly effective.
