jobs.title: Senior L&D Program Manager - Manager Programs
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Senior L&D Program Manager - Manager Programs, you will continue to develop and operate a best-in-class global Manager Development Program for Crusoe’s global manager population. This role is ideal for an experienced L&D strategist who moves quickly, thrives in fast-paced environments, and brings instructional precision, big-picture thinking, and operational excellence.

You will balance high-level strategy with hands-on execution—designing and facilitating manager experiences, curating learning journeys, and establishing data-driven feedback loops. Partnering directly with senior leaders across engineering, data center operations, manufacturing, and corporate teams, you will ensure our leaders are equipped to scale with Crusoe’s rapid growth.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Manager Program Facilitation & Iteration: Facilitate and continuously evolve Crusoe’s Manager Program (“Manager Bootcamp”), aligning content with company strategy, culture, and operational priorities.
* Manager Journey Curation: Build a cohesive, end-to-end development journey that connects managers to Crusoe’s mission, business model, and organizational impact.
* Modular & Functional Tracks: Partner with internal teams (HR / People, Talent Development, senior leadership) to build modular and team-specific development tracks tailored to technical, manufacturing, and data center operational teams.
* Program Operations & Metrics: Build robust measurement frameworks and feedback loops to evaluate program effectiveness, track leadership performance metrics, and optimize operational delivery.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with People, IT, Workplace, and business leaders to create seamless, high-touch manager experiences.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8–10+ Years of L&D Leadership: Proven track record in Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or Instructional Design, with explicit experience scaling manager programs inside technical, engineering, or industrial organizations.
* Technical Org Fluency: Deep understanding of how engineering, technical operations, and manufacturing leads operate, what motivates them, and how to build credibility in highly technical cultures.
* Data-Driven Approach: Expertise using workforce analytics and learning metrics to evaluate program ROI, identify performance risks, and justify strategic interventions.
* Program Execution: Equal parts strategic architect and hands-on builder; comfortable designing frameworks from scratch in ambiguous, fast-growing environments.
* Enthusiasm for Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to global offices, manufacturing sites, and data centers as needed (approx. 25% travel).

**Bonus Points**

* Organizational Development Background: Advanced grounding in adult learning theory or organizational effectiveness.
* Modern L&D Tech Stack: Hands-on familiarity with tools such as WorkRamp, Lattice, Confluence, or modern LMS/knowledge platforms.
* Infrastructure Tech Context: Genuine curiosity about AI systems, hardware manufacturing, and the physical data center infrastructure powering future technologies.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $160,000 - $195,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

**Title:** **Case** **Management** **Program** **Manager**

**Classification**: **Full-time, Exempt**

**Reports** **to:** **Chief of Staff**

**Supervises:** **Case Managers and Patient Navigators**

**Annual Salary $80,000-$95,000**

ABOUT RITTER CENTER:

For over 40 years, Ritter Center has worked to prevent and resolve homelessness and improve the health, dignity, and well-being of people living in poverty in Marin.

When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.

We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

**Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  
  
Ritter Center is currently recruiting for a Program Manager for our Case Management Department. This full-time, exempt position reports to the Chief of Staff based in San Rafael, CA; the role ***operates out of our main Campus.***

The Case Management Program Manager is an integral role in Ritter Center’s dynamic multidisciplinary team of medical, behavioral health and case management professionals who provide integrated care to our target population. This position reports directly to the Chief of Staff and supervises a team of 7 employees comprised of 3 Case Managers and 3 Patient Navigators and 1 Admin Coordinator. The Program Manager also provides a limited amount of direct client services while managing the work of the team. The services are: Representative Payee, Patient Navigation, Rapid Rehousing funds, Housing First (HBCM), and Custody to Community. This position also serves as the Agency Lead for the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) to ensure timely and accurate data entry across all agency HMIS users. This role leads efforts to triage all drop-in case management and referral services and oversees the coordination of overall client flow.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Recruit, hire, train and supervise a team of Case Managers and Patient Navigators providing trauma-informed care across a comprehensive and diverse range of programs to ensure effective services and outcomes.
* Conduct regular team meetings and individual supervision sessions.
* Oversee the day-to-day operations, service quality, and client flow of Case Management programs while ensuring compliance with all legal, regulatory, contractual, and funding requirements.
* Meet regularly with Chief of Staff and attend staff meetings and training as scheduled.
* Function as a part of a multidisciplinary team to support the engagement and services for chronically homeless individuals and families with severe and persistent mental illness, physical disabilities, and/or substance use.
* Collaborate with Accounting to verify compliance and accurate tracking of Housing First rental subsidy payments, Rapid Rehousing payments, Rental Assistance payments, Representative Payee accounts management and Social Security reporting.
* Attend and represent Ritter Center at all required County level case conferencing, advocacy, and policy meetings as well as community events and media appearances when requested.
* Oversee accurate record-keeping, documentation, reporting, and retention of client and program records within HMIS and other organizational systems.
* Partner with the Clinical staff to ensure integration of clinical services.
* Supervise and provide strategic direction for case management staff, including leading meetings, performance evaluations, and professional coaching.
* Ensure effective onboarding, performance management, and policy adherence of staff supervised.
* Maintain high staff morale to enable a positive and inclusive culture.
* Work collaboratively to enhance service integration within the organization and non-profit community partners throughout Marin County.
* Serve as a member of the leadership team. Contribute to the development of and adhere to Ritter Center’s goals, objectives, policies and procedures.
* Support Quality Improvement (QI) activities; collect, analyze and report data regarding client services according to all case management contracts as well as organizational-wide QI measures.
* Collaborate closely with Marin County Continuum of Care (CoC) partner Community Based Organizations (CBO), and other Social Service agencies to ensure appropriate support and referrals are being made by the team.
* Oversee resolution of complex service challenges and guide staff in developing effective approaches and solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Per our Federally Qualified Healthcare Center (FQHC) requirements employment at Ritter Center requires compliance with being able to produce a negative TB test prior to the start of employment, as well as being vaccinated against COVID-19 (unless applying for an exemption) per the August 5, 2020 State Public Order for Healthcare Facilities, providers and employees.
* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, Criminal Justice, or another behavioral or social science field.
* Equivalent experience (2+ years) in benefits administration, Representative Payee services, case management, or a closely related field. Additional experience may be substituted for a degree.
* Experience with social services in Marin County is highly preferred.
* Prior management experience in a social services setting, including employee supervision, implementation of new service models, program management, and ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with budgeting and accounting practices is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About this Opportunity:**  
At Regency Centers, our people are our greatest asset, and we believe that our highly skilled and talented team makes us better. We are seeking a full-time Project Manager (Construction) to join our regional office located in Walnut Creek, California. The Project Manager leads construction across an assigned portfolio of existing shopping centers, with a primary focus on tenant improvements, landlord work, redevelopment, space reconfigurations, and property capital improvements. They manage budgets, schedules, consultants, and contractors from scope development and design through permitting, construction, tenant turnover, and closeout. This position works closely with Leasing, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Development Accounting to meet lease obligations and operating needs while coordinating work around existing tenants and customers. The Project Manager handles multiple concurrent projects and may support major ground-up developments as assigned.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**  

* Manage construction at existing shopping centers, including landlord work, tenant improvements, white box work, vacant space preparation, space divisions, redevelopment, and facade renovations. Ensure delivery is on time, on budget, and consistent with lease, design, and brand standards.
* Assist with ground up development projects.
* Collaborate with Leasing, Tenant Coordination, Property Management, and Legal to define landlord delivery obligations, evaluate scopes of work, and align lease language and construction exhibits. Coordinate landlord work with tenant delivery requirements.
* Lead budgeting and scheduling for tenant, redevelopment, and property construction projects, including estimates for landlord lease obligations and capital improvements. Monitor and forecast costs, address risks, and track deviations from plan.
* Oversee the preparation and execution of construction contracts and change orders in partnership with Contract Administration. Ensure contractor performance, insurance compliance, and lien waiver documentation.
* Manage existing condition assessments, design, permitting, and utility coordination for tenant work, redevelopment, and property improvements. Evaluate constructability, support entitlement approvals when needed, and plan construction phasing to limit disruption to tenants and customers.
* Manage assigned property capital improvements in coordination with Property Management, including roof replacements, parking lot reconstruction, facade work, HVAC replacements, and major site or building system upgrades.
* Track project milestones, landlord completion dates, and closeout requirements. Maintain project reporting tools and internal dashboards, and provide regular updates to construction leadership, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Accounting.

Are You Qualified?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field
* Minimum five (5) years of retail or commercial construction management experience, to include supervisory experience
* Ability to travel regionally & frequently visit all assigned construction sites
* Ability to work varying and flexible hours as needed for tenant delivery, construction in operating shopping centers, and public meetings
* Experience with tenant improvements, redevelopment, and construction in operating shopping centers preferred
* Knowledge of retail construction, tenant improvements, redevelopment, existing building systems, and permitting
* Skilled in reviewing documents for conformity to standards of Regency jurisdictions and/or tenants
* Ability to comprehend architectural and engineering drawings and complex legal documents
* Proficiency with personal computers and MS Office, MS Excel, MS Project, Zoom, & JD Edwards software
* Skilled in analyzing construction costs for landlord lease obligations, tenant improvements, redevelopment, and property capital projects and recommending budgetary adjustments as appropriate
* Regency Centers will not sponsor employment-based immigration petitions or applications for this position, including but not limited to H-1B, TN visa, or permanent residency.

**Personal Traits We Value:**  

* Project management skills (planning, organizing, informing, directing others)
* Decisiveness, problem-solving, time-management, multi-tasking and presentation skills
* Communication skills (interpersonal savvy, customer focus, oral and written communication)
* Trust and integrity
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work within a team environment

**A Little Bit About Us:**  
We own and operate premier shopping centers in suburban neighborhoods in the top cities and markets across the country. We live by a strong set of values, which have guided us for more than 60 years.
  
  
Our centers thrive with highly productive grocers, restaurants, service providers, and terrific retailers that connect to their communities and customers. We are also active developers of new shopping centers that feature great merchandising, placemaking, and customer engagement as part of our Fresh Look™ program.
  
  
We are a vertically integrated real estate company and a qualified real estate investment trust (REIT) that is self-administered, self-managed, and an S&P 500 Index member. Learn more about us at RegencyCenters.com.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
Our compensation and benefits package is very competitive and includes the following benefits and more. For additional information visit www.regencycenters.com/careers.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  

* 23+ PTO days annually
* 11 paid holidays (in addition to PTO)
* Paid leave programs (parental, compassion, bereavement, jury duty, and military)
* Health Advocacy + Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Financial Security
  

* 401(k) with a generous company match plus corporate profit sharing
* Anniversary stock grant awards
* Health Savings Account

jobs.title: Knowledge Archiving & Support Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a **Knowledge Archiving and Support (KAS) Program Manager** to work within the Knowledge Management program. You will be responsible for overseeing Strategic Deterrence's (SD) digitization operations, knowledge preservation and curation, and access to legacy technical materials through the Research & Knowledge Services and Digitization Services teams. You will manage team leaders and staff across both service areas, oversee assigned budgets, sponsor and stakeholder relationships, including federal program reporting, and lead service-area planning and operational governance for digitization, archiving, and knowledge-structuring activities. You will coordinate closely with the Taxonomy Program and Knowledge Applications team on metadata standards, semantic governance, and repository integration, though semantic model development itself sits outside this role’s scope. This position will be in the Administration Division within the Operations and Business Directorate and is matrixed to the Strategic Deterrence (SD) Directorate.

*This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options, may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.*

**You will**

* Oversee day-to-day management of the Research & Knowledge Services and Digitization Services teams, including direct supervision of the Research & Knowledge Services Team Lead and Digitization Services Team Lead.
* Track program budget and manage relationships with federal program managers and stakeholders (e.g., NA-115); provide monthly reporting to the NA-115 portfolio manager.
* Lead service-area planning for SD digitization, archiving, and knowledge-preservation activities, aligned with SD priorities; coordinate with the Taxonomy Program Manager to ensure appropriate application of metadata standards to digitized and repository content.
* Establish and oversee adoption of a prioritization framework for digitization activities and SD digitization standards, including sustaining a formal digitization governance framework (e.g., Federal Agencies Digital Guidelines Initiative (FADGI) compliance, permanent-records digitization pilots) as an ongoing operational practice.
* Provide operational oversight and escalation management for KAS-supported Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) activities, partnering with the FOIA coordinator on process and workload management.
* Resolve cross-functional operational gaps affecting digitization and reference services (e.g., intake processes, coverage of physically distributed digitization spaces, coordination with partner organizations handling related materials).
* Serve as PI/budget owner for KAS staffing actions within Research & Knowledge Services and Digitization Services.
* Represent KAS in program-level planning and stakeholder engagement in coordination with the Taxonomy Program Manager and Knowledge Applications Product Manager.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. Citizenship.
* Bachelor’s degree in Library and Information Science, Archives and Records Administration, History, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
* Broad and in-depth knowledge of business planning, budgeting, performance metrics, project planning, and data analysis for service operations areas.
* Experience managing a diverse group of staff, including supervisory experience over other supervisors or team leads.
* Experience managing relationships with federal or external program sponsors, including regular reporting.
* Experience with digitization operations, records management, and metadata practices.

**Qualifications We Desire**

* Master’s degree in Library and Information Science, Archives and Records Administration, History, or a related field.
* Experience with FADGI or other digitization/preservation standards.
* Experience with FOIA processes.
* Experience with document management systems or institutional repository software.

At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

The Logistics Security Analyst, assigned to one of Pinkerton’s largest global clients, will be a part of a diverse team within the centralized hub of prototype supply chain support. This role utilizes security operations and/or logistics experience to provide expertise in the tracking of safe arrival shipments, risk assessments to identify process improvements, and data reporting and root cause analysis. jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Why join us?**  
At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale

  

**The Role**

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE-ADS) department is part of GM’s Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization. SAFE-ADS serves as a central body for automated driving system (ADS) safety assurance, bringing together technical expertise from across the company to support the safe development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement of advanced driving capabilities.

  

GM is seeking an **Autonomous Vehicle Safety Case Technical Program Manager** to lead the integrated execution of complex, cross-functional safety cases for ADS. This senior/staff individual contributor will bring structure, momentum, and transparency to the workstreams that support GM’s ADS safety case and safety assurance strategy.

The role will coordinate technical and operational work across safety case management, safety and risk management systems, operational safety and human factors, aggregate safety and rules-of-the-road metrics, counterfactual simulation, and related system-safety interfaces. The successful candidate will connect strategy to execution: translating safety objectives into actionable plans, aligning claims and sufficiency criteria with evidence and assessments, managing dependencies and risks, and driving decisions to closure across engineering, validation, operations, legal, public policy, and product teams.

  

This role is ideal for an experienced program leader who is comfortable operating in a technically complex, safety-critical environment; can synthesize diverse inputs into a coherent execution plan; and is motivated by the challenge of enabling the safe, measurable, and scalable deployment of ADS technology.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Integrated Program Leadership

* Build and maintain integrated program plans covering safety case workstreams, milestones, dependencies, resource needs, risks, decisions, and deliverables.

* Establish operating rhythms, governance forums, status reporting, action tracking, decision logs, and escalation paths that enable effective cross-functional execution.

* Align safety case claims with ADS product, engineering, validation, operational, and launch milestones.

* Translate evolving safety strategies and program objectives into clear workstream charters, measurable outcomes, delivery plans, and ownership models.

* Identify schedule, scope, technical, evidence, resource, and cross-functional dependency risks; drive mitigation plans and escalate issues when needed.

* Create clear, concise communications for technical teams, senior leaders, and cross-functional decision forums.

Safety Case and Assurance Execution

* Coordinate the development, assessment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ADS safety cases across product-launch contexts.

* Drive alignment among safety claims, sufficiency criteria, evidence plans, assessment activities, and program milestones.

* Establish and maintain traceability between safety strategies, claims, requirements, evidence, assessments, decisions, and changes in system scope or operating conditions.

* Coordinate technical inputs from AI/ML, autonomy, systems engineering, functional safety, SOTIF, cybersecurity, software validation, simulation, human factors, operations, and product safety teams.

* Track evidence readiness, assessment status, substantiation gaps, deviations, and corrective actions; ensure gaps are closed, actively managed, or supported by documented rationale.

* Support impact assessments when the ADS, operational design domain, platform, release, feature behavior, or deployment plan changes.

* Improve the processes, tools, and information flows used to manage the safety case and safety assurance lifecycle.

Continuous Improvement

* Establish scalable methods for planning, prioritization, reporting, evidence management, and change control across SAFE-ADS.

* Use program data and operational feedback to identify systemic issues, improve process health, and increase predictability of safety assurance delivery.

* Promote early and frequent collaboration between safety assurance teams and the engineering and operations organizations developing and deploying ADS capabilities.

Help mature GM’s safety assurance practices as ADS technology, operating scope, evidence methods, and industry expectations evolve.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, systems engineering, robotics, safety engineering, mathematics, or a related technical field.

* 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in autonomous vehicles, ADAS, software-intensive systems, systems engineering, product safety, safety assurance, or another safety-critical domain.

* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, and enterprise-level visibility.

* Strong program management capabilities, including integrated planning, milestone management, dependency tracking, risk management, governance, issue resolution, and executive communication.

* Experience translating ambiguous technical or safety objectives into structured execution plans, measurable outcomes, and clear ownership.

* Experience developing, supporting, assessing, or managing safety cases, assurance cases, safety arguments, or equivalent evidence-based

**About Us**
============

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

**Role Summary**
================

RVT vehicles for Volkswagen Group programs combine RVT zonal and platform ECUs with secondary ECUs (2nd ECUs) supplied by the VWG brands. Every RVT domain team has to integrate against those 2nd ECUs, and all of it depends on a shared network interface definition. Today that definition is largely handed to us by VWG and our domains are mainly taking in what they receive. We need to move to a world where each RVT domain owns its interfaces and changes flow incrementally rather than in large releases.

You will join the SW Systems Architecture team and partner with the interface architecture leads to run the network interface program inside RVT, drive the transition from consuming VWG's definition to domain owned interfaces, roll out the frameworks the architects define for 2nd ECUs, and give domain teams and leadership one current view of where each 2nd ECU stands. The architects set the technical direction. You turn it into a plan, a cadence and a set of artifacts the organization can execute against.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Own the program plan for taking the RVT network interface to a fully defined and versioned baseline for each VWG program (Package 1, Package 2.1, Package 2.2 and beyond).
* Map out and drive the transition plan, per domain and per program, for moving interface ownership from VWG into the RVT domains, including what has to be true at each step and where the interim dependencies on VWG remain.
* Document and roll out the workflow the architects define for network interface versioning and change management inside RVT, including how incoming VWG interface changes are reviewed, how deltas reach the domains and how changes get closed out.
* Run the domain review cadence for interface changes and chase open items to closure across the domain teams.
* Coordinate network definition change requests from VWG, making sure impact is assessed by the right RVT owners and the outcome gets back to VWG.
* Roll out the framework the architects define for what has to be captured per 2nd ECU (functional spec, network interface needs, SW and HW version plan, OTA compliance, integration prerequisites), drive the domains to fill it in, and roll up the results.
* Maintain the up to date view of 2nd ECU maturity and risk per program that can be escalated to RVT and VWG leadership, and make the gaps visible when information from the brands does not exist.
* Operate the handoff between architecture level definition and the active integration tracking owned by the domain and program TPM teams.
* Set up the forums, status rhythm and documentation for this area, and act as the point of contact for VWG TPM counterparts on networking and 2nd ECU planning.

**Qualifications**
==================

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* 8+ years of technical program management on products that integrate hardware, software and mechanical systems, including embedded or vehicle programs taken from concept to production.
* Strong organization and the ability to influence and move an organization without direct authority, across every domain team and two parent companies.
* Experience planning and driving multi-step transitions of ownership or process across teams while the program keeps moving.
* Comfort in ambiguity. You can take a framework from the technical leads, turn it into a working process and artifacts, and iterate as the program evolves.
* Enough hands-on software or hardware background to follow architecture discussions and ask the right questions of architects and domain engineers.
* Experience bridging Agile and waterfall processes across partner organizations. Advanced Jira and Confluence.

-----------------

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What You’ll Do**

The Enterprise Technical Project Manager provides project management leadership for complex, technology-driven initiatives that support firmwide business transformation and operational objectives. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle for technical solutions, coordinating cross-functional technical and business teams, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality technology outcomes. The Enterprise Technical Project Manager applies disciplined project management practices while navigating technical complexity, enterprise governance, and interdependencies across systems and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned enterprise technical projects from initiation through execution, closeout, and transition to ongoing operations or product ownership.
* Partner with executive sponsors and business stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, success criteria, and business cases.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies for technical initiatives.
* Coordinate cross-functional technical teams, including architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors, to deliver project outcomes.
* Facilitate project governance activities, including status reporting, risk and issue management, and change control.
* Manage project dependencies, constraints, and inter-project coordination across portfolios and business units.
* Oversee vendor selection, contracting support, and vendor performance management when third-party resources are involved.
* Monitor and manage project budgets, including forecasts, capitalization considerations, and approval workflows.
* Ensure technical solutions meet quality, security, compliance, and resiliency requirements in partnership with architecture, security, and risk teams.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and production release activities.
* Support change readiness, stakeholder communications, and training coordination to promote adoption of technical project deliverables.
* Lead project transition into production and ensure handoff to Product Management or operational support teams.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across project teams.
* Use approved AI tools responsibly to improve project planning, analysis, communication, and delivery efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and complying with firm policies for data privacy, security, confidentiality, and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
* 5–8+ years of experience managing technology-driven or enterprise IT projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) within technical environments.
* Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and vendor engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology delivery, SDLC practices, and integration considerations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow PPM, including Project Workspace.
* Proficiency with project management and delivery tools (e.g., MS Project, MS Planner, Smartsheet, Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Project management certifications (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system interactions and technical dependencies.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities in large-scale technical environments.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Experience working within enterprise governance, security, and risk management frameworks.

#Remote

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $108,200.00 - $221,100.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm.

jobs.title: Legal Operations Program Manager, M&A Integrations
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

We are looking for a high-impact Legal Operations Program Manager to join our expanding Legal Operations Team and sit at the center of our mergers & acquisitions (M&A) activity! This is a strategy-to-execution role focused on post-acquisition integration: bringing acquired companies' legal teams, legal entities, contracts, litigation and matters, outside counsel relationships, and compliance obligations into the Lyft Legal organization. To be clear, this is a business and organizational M&A integration role, not a systems or technology integration role. You will serve as the operating backbone for Legal across our most strategic transactions, owning the legal workstream of M&A integration in partnership with Lyft's Corporate Development Integration Management Office (IMO), along with the intake and governance layer that connects the Legal team to deal work. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, proactive, and able to drive outcomes across multiple concurrent acquisitions in ambiguous, high-stakes environments with a collaborative and transparent approach. Some key areas include: M&A integration program management, program leadership across concurrent deals, cross-functional and deal team engagement, outside counsel and vendor management across jurisdictions, legal entity management and governance, and building a repeatable M&A integration operating model that scales with company growth. This position reports to the Head of Legal Operations.

As the company scales, the volume and complexity of strategic transactions — acquisitions, cross-border expansion, and new market entry — continues to increase. This role establishes a centralized operating model for the legal side of M&A integration that ensures:

* Acquisitions are integrated into Lyft Legal with discipline, completeness, and a clear critical path
* Legal is embedded early in each deal, from diligence through post-close, with strong planning-to-execution across multiple teams to deliver strong business results and manage risk
* The organization scales without inheriting unmanaged legal, contractual, or compliance risk from acquired companies

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **M&A Integration Program Management**
  + Own the legal workstream of M&A integration across global acquisitions, from integration planning during diligence through post-close, in partnership with Corporate Development's Integration Management Office (IMO)
  + Build legal M&A integration roadmaps with clear dependencies and critical path, covering people, entities, contracts, matters, and compliance obligations, and stand up governance, reporting, and escalation frameworks for each acquisition
  + Prepare and lead leadership readouts on the legal integration status of each acquisition in scope
  + Track the retirement of inherited legal risk and post-close obligations, and codify repeatable legal M&A integration playbooks to improve speed, quality, and predictability
* **Program Leadership & Execution**
  + Act as the control tower across concurrent acquisitions, ensuring legal integration work is resourced, sequenced, and prioritized appropriately across teams
  + Build and manage integrated plans, milestones, and KPIs, and drive execution across multiple complex, cross-functional deal workstreams simultaneously
  + Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks, holding teams accountable while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships
  + Maintain high-quality documentation, decision logs, and scalable processes
* **Cross-Functional Engagement & Deal Support**
  + Partner across Corporate Development, Finance, People, Tax, Security, and the business to understand each deal's integration plan and identify impacts on the Legal team's people, processes, and organization

jobs.title: Financial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
The Finance Operations team at Zoox sits at the center of the Finance organization. The team consolidates planning inputs from across FP&A into a single companywide financial forecast, and reports actuals and forecast performance upward to Zoox leadership and to Amazon. Finance Operations also owns the controls behind how Zoox commits and spends money: governing purchase requisition and purchase order intake, enforcing accounting policy and GL coding standards at the point of commitment, and validating that spend ties out to budget.

As a Finance Operations Analyst, you will serve as the first line of review for purchase requisitions across Zoox, ensuring every commitment is structured, coded, and approved in compliance with U.S. GAAP and Zoox accounting policy. Reporting to the Manager, Finance Operations, you will partner daily with budget owners across Engineering, Operations, and G&A, with the FP&A lead analysts who own each spending area, and with Accounting on coding and capitalization questions. Beyond transactional review, you will support month-end close through open PO cleanup and accrual data, and build the recurring reporting that shows Finance leadership where committed spend stands against budget.

This role requires a solid understanding of U.S. GAAP and procure-to-pay processes, along with the judgment to know when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate it. You will leverage SAP S4, SAP Ariba, and other internal reporting systems to analyze spend data and provide actionable insights that improve compliance, spend visibility, and the efficiency of the requisition process.

### **In this role you will:**

* Review purchase requisitions for compliance with U.S. GAAP and Zoox accounting policies
* Conduct pre-approval compliance checks of purchase orders against budget and forecast models, escalating discrepancies to the appropriate lead analyst within FP&A
* Conduct Forecast vs. Actuals (FvA) analysis during monthly and quarterly closes
* Review agreements and contracts to determine appropriate PR structure and coding, and re-structure PRs and POs as policies change
* Partner with business owners to resolve incomplete or non-compliant purchase requisitions, and guide requesters and the internal team on PR requirements and accounting policy

new_jobs.title: Technology Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**  
  
Do you want to help executives navigate technology disruption at a scale and speed they've never faced before? Are you the kind of person who sees a hard problem and leans in instead of looking away? You're exactly who we're looking for.  
  
AI is reshaping industries overnight. Global markets are shifting faster than playbooks can keep up. Entire business models are being rewritten in real time. For the leaders steering through it, this isn't a moment for more of the same... it's a moment that demands fresh thinking, bold moves, and partners who can see around corners. There has never been a more exciting time to be a strategic advisor - join us for this moment!  
  
**Is this You?**  
  
You're drawn to hard problems, not easy answers. You vibe code for fun. You're curious about how technology is disrupting an industry at a rapid pace before it ever makes the news. You read about a company making a bold strategic bet and find yourself thinking about what drove the decision, and how to execute that vision.  
  
You don't need to have it all figured out yet or arrive as a technology expert. But you learn quickly, care about creating value for organizations, not just how a plan might read on a page. You're sharp enough to find the signal in messy data. You're genuinely excited about AI, not as a buzzword, but as something you want to learn to use responsibly, for both delivery transformation and as an enabler, in high-stakes situations. And you're ambitious enough to want your work to matter starting now, not eventually.  
  
If you want to become the kind of advisor executives trust with their hardest decisions, it **starts at Deloitte as an Enterprise Tech Strategy Analyst.**  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 11/01/2026.  
  
**What You'll Do**  
  
Your work will feed the decisions executives can't afford to get wrong. Here's what that looks like day to day: you'll get a problem that isn't fully defined, and part of your job is figuring out the right question before you can even get to an answer. You'll dig into data, build the analysis, and find the insight that changes how a client sees their situation; you'll be exposed to the latest AI tools and accelerators. You will learn to communicate your recommendation clearly to Executives who've been running companies longer than you've been in the workforce.  
  
The questions you will wrestle with sit at the center of enterprise transformation:  

* What target technology state will enable the company's strategy?
* Which platforms, data, and AI capabilities should be modernized, and in what sequence?
* How should cloud, architecture, cyber, and product or platform operating models evolve?
* Where can AI create differentiated value, and how can it be scaled responsibly?
* How should leaders address technology debt, investment tradeoffs, and the change required to activate the roadmap?

  
These are a few illustrative questions our clients are asking...and that you will address as part of our team! The work spans the full arc of strategic advising: diagnosing where a business stands, charting where it needs to go, shaping the modernization roadmap, designing the transformation required to get there, and even staying with the business to turn the solution on! You'll be expected to think, not just execute, and to bring a perspective into every conversation.  
  
The best strategies aren't measured by the quality of the deck, they're road-tested and measured by the value at scale that they create. Strategy and execution aren't separate disciplines. As an Enterprise Tech Strategy Analyst at Deloitte, you'll learn how to connect the two.  
  
**Required Qualifications**  

* Must be currently enrolled in an accredited college or university and expected to graduate by Spring/Summer 2027 pursuing a bachelor's degree or higher in one of the following majors or a related/equivalent program

* Info Systems
* Business
* Economics
* Engineering
* Computer Science
* Accounting
* Operations
* Supply Chain
* Liberal Arts
* Strong academic track record (3.3 cumulative GPA required, 3.5 cumulative GPA preferred).
* Must live within a commutable distance to your assigned office (g. 100-mile radius) with the ability to commute daily, ifrequired, uponstartdate
* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future  

  
  
This is an entry-level opportunity intended for candidates interested in beginning or building a career in this field. We welcome applicants from a range of educational and professional backgrounds who meet the qualifications for the role. For roles that require a year or more of work experience, please review the experienced jobs within our careers site.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $74,900 to $147,600.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.title: Climate and Soil Health Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

Reporting to the National Climate and Soil Health Deputy Director and Scientist, the Climate and Soil Health Program Manager supports AFT’s Climate and Soil Health Program by providing operational leadership for key priorities, managing outreach, communications, and stakeholder engagement, coordinating cross-functional implementation activities, and ensuring and contributing to delivery of funded project outcomes. The position supports AFT’s efforts to catalyze a new conventional agriculture: empowering farmers and ranchers across the nation’s diverse systems to achieve on-farm and societal benefits from systems that are soil health promoting, biodiverse, climate-neutral or better, resilient, equitable, and environmentally, economically, and socially sustainable.

**Position Summary**

As an integral part of the National Climate and Soil Health Program, the Climate and Soil Health Program Manager leads program outreach and metrics tracking, manages the roll out and maintenance of the virtual network platform, and manages communications, stakeholder engagement, resource dissemination, and other operational priorities that support successful delivery across the Climate and Soil Health Portfolio. The position collaborates across projects and teams to develop outreach and educational resources and events, facilitate partner engagement, support financial management and funder and impact reporting, and ensure that key tasks, deliverables, and communications move efficiently from planning to completion to facilitate successful and timely award and program outcomes. The Program Manager supports the Director, Deputy, and broader team by contributing to identification of implementation needs, addressing operational challenges, and contributing to the continued evolution of Climate and Soil Health programming strategies.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Programmatic management and support**

* Manage select partners, stakeholders, and AFT staff to achieve goals and deliverables set forth by the National Climate and Soil Health Program’s funders and other AFT teams as applicable;
* Lead, support and ensure successful implementation of assigned workstreams and deliverables for Climate and Soil Health related projects;
* Coordinate and contribute to the collection, documentation, organization, tracking, and reporting to funders of project outcomes, metrics, partner contributions, and deliverables.
* Lead and support outreach, communications, educational programming, producer engagement, and dissemination activities, including collaboration with internal and external partners to implement communications and engagement plans.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners, bridging across soil scientists, economists, farmers, on-the-ground technical assistants, suppliers and food companies, program managers, ag specialists and other contributors, to coordinate on-farm demonstration trials, implementation activities, information flow, resource creation, trainings, networks, and other project deliverables that support farmers in trialing, adopting, and/or continuing to use environmentally and economically sound practices or marketing their products with sustainability premiums and environmental services.
* Coordinate, contribute to, and support the development, review, publication, and dissemination, of science-based project resources, such as website content, outreach materials and plans, curricula, trainings, presentations, factsheets, farmer reports, public-facing reports, white papers, decision support tools, and peer-reviewed manuscripts, that support adoption of soil health practices and facilitate overall improvements in climate and soil health outcomes.
* Represent AFT at occasional project-related events, such as conferences, trainings, and meetings;
* Build, facilitate, and manage the Climate and Soil Health Program virtual network microsites within the greater AFT Higher Logic program.
* Coordinate and support development of external advisory committee to support improved feedback loops and project outcomes, particularly on improved market access for producers using environmentally and economically sound practices.

**Stakeholder, partnership and collaboration management for impact:**

**Location:** On-site - Central Maryland (Baltimore/Washington corridor); situational telework only as approved by the customer

**Focus Areas:** Requirements Management, Portfolio Analysis, Integrated Master Scheduling, Program Performance Analytics, Acquisition Planning Support

**Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Program Analyst / Requirements Manager to support a program management office in establishing, maintaining, and executing enterprise portfolio and requirements management processes. You will develop and apply the methodologies, tools, and documentation used to define, prioritize, schedule, cost, and track requirements across the enterprise.

You will partner with program managers and functional leaders to support the budget cycle, requirements intake and adjudication, and program execution, identifying duplicative, inefficient, or disconnected requirements and delivering timely, decision-quality analysis to senior leadership.

**What You'll Do**

* **Requirements Intake & Traceability:** Maintain an intake log for unfunded requirements and produce traceability artifacts, including problem statements, operational impacts, and preliminary cost/schedule considerations.

* **Requirements Repository & Portfolio Health:** Maintain a repository of historical decisions, dependencies, and rationale; deliver monthly portfolio health summaries highlighting bottlenecks, gaps, dependencies, and trends.
* **Integrated Master Schedule:** Build and maintain an enterprise IMS in MS Project aligned to an approved WBS; integrate stakeholder schedules, conduct monthly critical path and schedule risk assessments, and deliver monthly IMS update packages with variance narratives and trend charts.
* **Performance Analytics:** Develop and update a cost, schedule, and performance dashboard with variance analysis, quarterly program health metrics, and a risk, issue, and opportunity register.
* **Cost Savings & Rationalization:** Identify measurable cost savings and cost avoidance through portfolio rationalization (e.g., eliminating duplicative software licenses).
* **Acquisition Planning Support:** Conduct market research for specialized technical tools and equipment, assess technology readiness and supply chain lead times, refine purchase descriptions, recommend acquisition strategies, and draft justification documentation for customer review.
* **Change & Risk Communication:** Manage the change lifecycle for processes and systems and proactively communicate risks, issues, and opportunities to leadership.

**Who You Are (Required Qualifications)**

* **Large Program Experience:** Specialized experience leading large, complex projects for government customers.
* **Scheduling Expertise:** Hands-on experience developing and managing schedules in MS Project.

* **Earned Value & Project Controls:** Knowledge of and experience with Earned Value Management and project control concepts.

* **Analysis & Reporting:** Proven ability to synthesize complex information into comprehensive reports that inform senior-level decisions.

**Preferred Skills**

* PMP, EVM, or similar project controls certification.
* Experience supporting planning, programming, budgeting, and execution (PPBE) cycles.
* Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel.
* Experience supporting requirements prioritization or investment review boards.

**Required Education + Experience**

* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of relevant experience, Master's degree and 6+ years, or PhD and 3+ years.

**GENERAL PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS:**

* **Citizenship:** Must be a U.S. Citizen.

* **Work Location:** On-site at the customer facility in Central Maryland. Telework is situational and must be pre-approved by the customer.
* **Travel:** Occasional local and CONUS travel may be required to support meetings, events, and engagements.

new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We are seeking an IT Project Manager to plan and deliver technology projects that support organisational priorities. This role is responsible for coordinating people, budgets, timelines, risks, and dependencies throughout the project lifecycle, while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders and ensuring delivery meets agreed requirements. The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise with a practical understanding of IT environments, effective stakeholder engagement, and a focus on measurable outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead IT projects from initiation and planning through delivery, implementation, transition, and closure

* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, success measures, and governance in collaboration with stakeholders

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, RAID logs, and supporting documentation

* Coordinate project teams across IT, product, operations, suppliers, and business functions to support timely and effective delivery

* Manage project dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and change requests, escalating concerns and agreeing appropriate actions

* Monitor project progress against agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality, and benefits, taking corrective action where required

* Facilitate project meetings, workshops, planning sessions, and decision-making forums, ensuring actions and decisions are recorded and followed up

* Provide clear, regular project updates to sponsors, senior leaders, delivery teams, and other stakeholders

* Manage stakeholder expectations and build constructive working relationships across technical and non-technical teams

* Oversee procurement and supplier engagement for project activities, including deliverables, performance, costs, and contractual dependencies

* Support requirements gathering and ensure that solutions align with business needs, technical standards, security requirements, and operational considerations

* Coordinate testing, user acceptance, training, communications, deployment, and business readiness activities

* Plan handover to operational teams and ensure support arrangements, documentation, and ownership are in place before project closure

* Track project benefits and outcomes, capturing lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement

* Apply appropriate project management methods, controls, and governance, adapting delivery approaches to project complexity and organisational requirements

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant experience managing IT projects through the full project lifecycle

* Proven ability to develop and manage project plans, budgets, schedules, resources, risks, issues, and dependencies

* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and delivering technology projects involving multiple stakeholders

* Strong understanding of project governance, change control, reporting, quality management, and benefits tracking

* Ability to communicate project status, risks, decisions, and technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills

* Excellent organisation, prioritisation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail

* Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing requirements and delivery constraints

* Working knowledge of IT delivery environments, including software, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, or business systems projects

* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools, such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms

* Understanding of information security, data protection, risk management, and change management considerations in IT projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project management certification, such as PRINCE2, APM, PMP, or an equivalent qualification

* Experience delivering projects using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies

* Experience managing cloud migration, infrastructure, systems implementation, software development, cybersecurity, or digital transformation projects

* Experience managing external suppliers, consultants, contracts, procurement processes, and service transition

* Experience working with project portfolio management, financial tracking, or enterprise project governance processes

* Familiarity with IT service management practices, including ITIL, operational readiness, and support handover

### **Position Description & Qualifications**

  
  

If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting projects for the US Navy- Serco has a terrific opportunity for you!

As the HR Analytics Specialist, you will be on a dynamic team providing technical and programmatic support to the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine Program Offices! Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors and contribute and influence the Navy's future, premier nuclear submarines.

**Must possess an active U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance**

Team Submarine unites the Program Executive Officer, Undersea Warfare Systems (PEO UWS); the Deputy Commander, Undersea Technology (SEA 07); Program Executive Officer, Attack Submarine (PEO SSN); Program Executive Officer, Strategic Subs (PEO SSBN) and the Submarine Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Procurement (SUBMEPP) Activity, once diverse submarine-related commands and activities, into a single "submarine-centric" team. Conceived to increase efficiencies within the submarine acquisition, maintenance, and modernization communities, Team Submarine eliminates traditional "stovepipe" structures and processes that created impediments and inefficiencies in the submarine research, development, acquisition, and maintenance communities. Team Submarine provides improved communication among the various offices that contribute to the overall success of the United States Submarine Force.

We are looking for an energetic, enthusiastic and exceptional person to serve as a highly skilled HR Analytics Specialist with strong expertise in SharePoint development, list management, and workflow automation in the Washington, DC area. In this role, you will bridge the gap between HR data analytics and process optimization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for extracting and analyzing HR data to deliver actionable insights, while simultaneously maintaining, updating, and automating our HR data analytics through our SharePoint infrastructure and workflows. This is a hands-on technical role involves working directly with HR staffing and classification team, requiring a blend of analytical mindset, system administration skills, and process automation expertise.

In this role, you will:

* Utilizes modeling and analytic skills to determine costs associated with those resources. Examines identified personnel requirements and capabilities to optimize workforce and missions.

  + Design and build new SharePoint lists, custom views, and user forms to capture HR data efficiently.
  + Manage and audit user permissions, group access, and security configurations within SharePoint Online to ensure strict confidentiality of sensitive HR data.
  + Improve the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) of our internal HR SharePoint pages.
  + Design, build, and troubleshoot automated workflows and SharePoint lists (using Microsoft Power Automate / Microsoft Flow) which assist our HR staffing teams track workload.
  + Set up automated email alerts, approval flows, and status updates linked to SharePoint lists.
  + Integrate SharePoint Online with other Microsoft 365 applications (such as Teams, Power BI, Outlook, and Power Apps) to create seamless, automated end-to-end solutions.
  + Extract, clean, and analyze complex HR datasets from various systems (e.g., payroll, performance, recruiting, demographics).
  + Develop and maintain automated HR dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) using tools like Power BI or Advanced Excel.
  + Deliver insights and trends related to employee retention, turnover, headcount, and other critical HR metrics to support decision-making.
  + Identify data quality issues within SharePoint and connected systems, implementing corrective actions to maintain data integrity.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, technical field, or managerial discipline, or commensurate additional, related experience.

* **Must possess an active DoW Secret security clearance.**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in HR Analytics, HR Systems Administration (HRIS), Business Intelligence, or a closely related technical HR role.
* Advanced level understanding of DoD and US Navy mission, purpose, function and organization.
* Significant experience related to US Navy programs or operations.
* SharePoint development or Microsoft Power Apps experience
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, index-matching, and data formatting).
* Professional experience building interactive reports and dashboards in Power BI.
* M365 Ecosystem: Strong understanding of the broader Microsoft Office 365 environment (Teams, Power Apps, Forms, Outlook).
* To be able to travel 10%.

* Knowledge of Navy, NAVSEA or Team Submarine Human Capital policies and processes.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Contribute to the strategic direction of the business and support impactful mission outcomes as a **National Security Analyst Sr Principal** at GDIT. Here, you’ll enable the success of the most critical government missions and the growth of a meaningful career in Intelligence.

  
  

**MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT**
  
As a National Security Analyst Sr Principal, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of the DTRA client/program. See some of the duties and responsibilities listed below:

  
  

Provide instruction on the history of strategic nuclear arms control treaties and agreements and participate in group discussions and other periods of instruction to provide experience-based perspectives on U.S. nuclear arms control policy development and implementation considerations.

  
  

The instructor should have relevant experience with negotiating and/or implementing bilateral arms control agreements and treaties, either as a member of on-site teams; as a member of a negotiating body; or in an advisory capacity.

  
  

Experience should also include work that has or does contribute to the formation of arms control policy through professional engagements with the broader arms control community of the U.S. Government (USG), the private sector, and academia.

  
  

The instructor shall develop, prepare, and present the following blocks of instruction for each Fundamentals of Strategic Arms Control Implementation Course: An overview of the history of strategic arms control from 1968 to the present: Selected topics or issues (to be specified by the Government) pertaining to INF, START, and New START (i.e., technical issues, implementation topics, etc.).

  
  

Will serve as an expert perspective regarding the arms control concepts, national security priorities, and relevant arms control treaties—to include INF—that formed the basis of the original START compared to those supporting the New START.

  
  

The perspective should also be representative of emerging nuclear arms control regime policies and risk reduction measures from USG stakeholders, private industry, and academia.

  
  

The instructor will provide briefing materials and participate in panel discussions regarding relevant arms control treaties, agreements, and risk reduction measures, to include challenges to future nuclear agreement negotiations and implementation.

new_jobs.title: Mid-Level Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Work Where it Matters**

Akima Mission Optimization (AMO), an Akima company, is not just another federal logistics contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At AMO, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

**For our shareholders**, AMO provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

**For our government customers**, AMO delivers innovative administrative support services that streamline operations, and enhance productivity.

**As an AMO employee**, you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

Description:

AMO is looking for a Mid-Level Data Analyst to work in Indian Head, MD. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

The Mid-Level Data Analyst supports data-driven analysis, operations research, software integration and testing, and advanced analytics efforts. This role applies statistical, mathematical, programming, and data science techniques to analyze complex information, support analytics objectives, and develop meaningful insights. The position requires hands-on experience with data analysis tools, programming languages, databases, and analytical methodologies.

Responsibilities:

* Perform data analysis, data mining, statistical analysis, and operations research to support analytics objectives.
* Support software integration and testing activities, including analyzing, developing, and implementing test plans and test scripts.
* Use scripting languages such as Python and R to perform data analysis and advanced analytics.
* Apply data science packages, tools, and methodologies commonly used for advanced analytics.
* Apply statistical methods, operations research techniques, and analytical tools to evaluate data and support decision-making.
* Work with structured and unstructured data using technologies such as Structured Query Language (SQL) and Non-Structured Query Language (NoSQL).
* Build and support Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) pipelines.
* Work with Web Application Servers and Search Index technologies as applicable to data integration and analytics efforts.
* Apply data science, data mining, statistical, and graph algorithm techniques to support analytical requirements.
* Develop and use analytical solutions with tools and technologies such as Python, Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, NumPy, and Requests.
* Apply complex mathematical and statistical concepts to analyze data and solve operational and analytical problems.
* Use spreadsheets and related tools for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization.
* Support the development, testing, validation, and documentation of analytical solutions and data-driven products.
* Collaborate with technical and analytical teams to identify data sources, evaluate information, and support project objectives.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in a related field is desired. An Associate’s degree (AA/AS) and four (4) additional years of related experience may be substituted for the Bachelor’s degree.
* Seven (7) years of experience in operations research is required.
* Demonstrated experience applying statistical and operations research methods and tools.
* Experience with data analysis, data science, data mining, statistics, or advanced analytics.
* Experience with software integration and/or testing, including test plans and test scripts.
* Experience using scripting languages such as Python and R.
* Experience working with data science and advanced analytics packages and tools.
* Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience with APIs, ETL pipelines, Web Application Servers, and/or Search Index technologies.
* Experience using tools such as Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, NumPy, and Requests.
* Ability to apply mathematical and statistical concepts to complex analytical problems.
